title.zh: 卷五 本紀第五 文帝
title.raw: 卷五 本紀第五 文帝 Volume 5 Annals 5: Emperor Wen

sentences.zh: 景平二年七月中，少帝廢。

translations.literal: In the middle of the seventh month of Jingping year 2, the young emperor was deposed.
translations.idiomatic: In the middle of the seventh month of Jingping 2 (424 CE), the young emperor was deposed.

sentences.zh: 百官備法駕奉迎，入奉皇統。

translations.literal: All officials prepared the imperial chariot to welcome him and receive the imperial succession.
translations.idiomatic: The officials arrayed the imperial carriage to welcome him and install him in the imperial line.

sentences.zh: 行臺至江陵，進璽紱。

translations.literal: When the mobile imperial secretariat reached Jiangling, it presented the imperial seal and ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: When the mobile secretariat reached Jiangling, it presented the imperial seal and ribbon.

sentences.zh: 侍中臣琇、散騎常侍臣嶷之、中書監尚書令護軍將軍建城縣公臣亮、左衞將軍臣景仁、給事中游擊將軍龍鄉縣侯臣隆、越騎校尉都亭侯臣綱、給事黃門侍郎臣孔璩之、散騎侍郎臣劉思考、員外散騎侍郎臣潘盛、中書侍郎臣何尚之、羽林監封陽縣開國侯臣蕭思話、長兼尚書左丞德陽縣侯臣孫康、吏部郎中騎都尉臣張茂度、儀曹郎中臣徐長琳、倉部郎中臣庾俊之、都官郎中臣袁洵等上表曰：「臣聞否泰相革，數窮則變，天道所以不謟，卜世所以靈長。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Pei, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Yi, Director of the Palace Library and Director of the Masters of Writing, Protector of the Army, Duke of Jiancheng Liang, General of the Left Guard Jingren, Gentlemen of the Palace and General Who Strikes in Guerrilla Warfare, Marquis of Longxiang Long, Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry, Marquis of Duting Gang, Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Kong Qunzhi, Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Liu Sikao, Extraordinary Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Pan Sheng, Attendant of the Palace Library He Shangzhi, Supervisor of the Forest Guards, Marquis Who Opens a State of Fengyang Xiao Sihua, Concurrent Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Marquis of Deyang Sun Kang, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, Commandant of Cavalry Zhang Maodu, Director of the Ministry of Rites Xu Changlin, Director of the Ministry of Revenue Yu Junzhi, Director of the Ministry of Justice Yuan Xun, and others submitted a memorial, saying: "Your subjects have heard that decline and prosperity transform each other, and when the cycle reaches its end there is change; this is why the Way of Heaven does not grow stale and why oracle divination for dynastic longevity proves spiritually enduring."
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Pei, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Yi, Director of the Palace Library and Director of the Masters of Writing Protector of the Army Duke of Jiancheng Liang, General of the Left Guard Jingren, Gentlemen of the Palace and General Who Strikes in Guerrilla Warfare Marquis of Longxiang Long, Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Marquis of Duting Gang, Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Kong Qunzhi, Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Liu Sikao, Extraordinary Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Pan Sheng, Attendant of the Palace Library He Shangzhi, Supervisor of the Forest Guards Marquis Who Opens a State of Fengyang Xiao Sihua, Concurrent Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Marquis of Deyang Sun Kang, Director of the Ministry of Personnel Commandant of Cavalry Zhang Maodu, Director of the Ministry of Rites Xu Changlin, Director of the Ministry of Revenue Yu Junzhi, Director of the Ministry of Justice Yuan Xun, and others submitted a memorial: "We have heard that adversity and prosperity succeed each other, and when fate runs its course change follows—this is why Heaven’s way never grows stale and why auguries for a dynasty’s endurance hold true."

sentences.zh: 乃者運距陵夷，王室艱晦，九服之命，靡所適歸，高祖之業，將墜于地。

translations.literal: Recently the age’s momentum declined, the royal house fell into hardship and obscurity, and the mandate of the nine domains had nowhere to settle; the enterprise of the High Ancestor was about to fall to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Of late the age had declined, the royal house was in distress, and the mandate of the nine domains had nowhere to rest; the High Ancestor’s founding enterprise was on the verge of collapse.

sentences.zh: 賴基厚德深，人神同奬，社稷以寧，有生獲乂。

translations.literal: Relying on your profound virtue and deep foundation, men and spirits alike lent their aid, so the altars of state were secured and the living were brought to order.
translations.idiomatic: Thanks to your profound virtue and deep foundation, men and spirits alike lent their aid, the altars were secured, and the people were brought to peace.

sentences.zh: 伏惟陛下君德自然，聖明在御，孝悌著於家邦，風猷宣於蕃牧。

translations.literal: We respectfully consider that Your Majesty’s sovereign virtue is natural, your sagely brilliance holds the throne, filial piety and brotherly duty shine in your family and state, and your moral influence is proclaimed in the borderlands you govern.
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully consider that Your Majesty’s sovereign virtue is innate, your sagely brilliance holds the throne, filial piety and brotherly duty are manifest in your family and state, and your moral influence is proclaimed in the domains you govern.

sentences.zh: 是以徵祥雜沓，符瑞㸌煇。

translations.literal: Therefore auspicious signs came in profusion and talismans blazed with brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: Hence auspicious omens crowded in and talismans blazed with brilliance.

sentences.zh: 宗廟神靈，乃眷西顧，萬邦黎獻，望景託生。

translations.literal: The spirits of the ancestral temple turned their regard westward; the myriad states and all the people looked to your radiance and entrusted their lives to you.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits of the ancestral temple turned their gaze westward; the myriad states and all the people looked to your radiance and entrusted their lives to you.

sentences.zh: 臣等忝荷朝列，豫充將命，復集休明之運，再覩太平之業。

translations.literal: We, who unworthily bear office in the court, were privileged to carry out your command, and have again gathered in this age of splendor to witness once more an enterprise of great peace.
translations.idiomatic: We, who unworthily bear office at court, were privileged to carry your command and have again gathered in this age of splendor to witness an enterprise of great peace once more.

sentences.zh: 行臺至止，瞻望城闕，不勝喜說鳧藻之情，謹詣門拜表以聞。

translations.literal: The mobile secretariat has arrived; gazing upon the capital walls, we cannot contain our joy like ducks on duckweed; we respectfully come to the gate to bow and submit this memorial for your notice.
translations.idiomatic: The mobile secretariat has arrived; gazing upon the capital walls, we cannot contain our joy; we respectfully come to the gate to bow and submit this memorial for your notice.

sentences.zh: 」上答曰：「皇運艱弊，數鍾屯夷，仰惟崇基，感尋國故，永慕厥躬，悲慨交集。

translations.literal: The Emperor replied: "The imperial fortune has been hard pressed, and the cycle has struck repeated adversity. Looking up to the lofty foundation, I feel the nation’s past and forever mourn that person; grief and agitation mingle together."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor replied: "The imperial fortune has been hard pressed and the cycle has struck repeated adversity. Looking up to the lofty foundation, I feel the nation’s past and forever mourn that person; grief and agitation mingle together."

sentences.zh: 賴七百祚永，股肱忠賢，故能休否以泰，天人式序。

translations.literal: Relying on the enduring fortune of the seven hundred years, and on loyal and worthy arms and legs of the throne, we have been able to turn adversity to prosperity and put Heaven and man in their proper order.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on the enduring fortune of the seven hundred years and on loyal, worthy arms and legs of the throne, we have been able to turn adversity to prosperity and put Heaven and man in their proper order.

sentences.zh: 猥以不德，謬降大命，顧己兢悸，何以克堪。

translations.literal: I am unworthy and have wrongly received the great mandate; looking back at myself, how could I bear it?
translations.idiomatic: I am unworthy and have wrongly received the great mandate; looking back at myself, how could I bear it?

sentences.zh: 輒當暫歸朝庭，展哀陵寢，并與賢彥申寫所懷。

translations.literal: I shall for the time being return to the court, display mourning at the imperial tombs, and together with worthy men fully express what is in my heart.
translations.idiomatic: I shall for the time being return to court, display mourning at the imperial tombs, and together with worthy men fully express what is in my heart.

sentences.zh: 望體其心，勿為辭費。

translations.literal: I hope you will enter into my feelings and not make excessive protestations.
translations.idiomatic: I hope you will enter into my feelings and not make excessive protestations.

sentences.zh: 」府州佐史並稱臣，請題牓諸門，一依宮省，上不許。

translations.literal: The prefectural and district aides all styled themselves subjects and asked to inscribe plaques on every gate according to the palace standard; the Emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectural and district aides all styled themselves subjects and asked to inscribe plaques on every gate according to the palace standard; the Emperor did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，發江陵。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, he set out from Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, he set out from Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，車駕至京城。

translations.literal: On bingshen of the eighth month, the imperial carriage reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen of the eighth month, the imperial carriage reached the capital.

sentences.zh: [1]丁酉，謁初寧陵，還於中堂即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On dingyou, he paid respects at the Chuning Mausoleum, then returned to the central hall and there assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, he paid respects at the Chuning Mausoleum, then returned to the central hall and there assumed the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 元嘉元年秋八月丁酉，大赦天下，改景平二年為元嘉元年。

translations.literal: On dingyou of the eighth month of autumn in the first year of Yuanjia, a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire, and Jingping year 2 was changed to Yuanjia year 1.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the eighth month of autumn in Yuanjia 1 (424 CE), a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire, and Jingping 2 was changed to Yuanjia 1.

sentences.zh: 文武賜位二等，逋租宿債勿復收。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were advanced two ranks in status; overdue rents and old debts were not to be collected again.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were advanced two ranks in status; overdue rents and old debts were not to be collected again.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以行撫軍將軍、荊州刺史謝晦為撫軍將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Acting Pacifying Army General and Jingzhou Inspector Xie Hui was made Pacifying Army General and Jingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Acting Pacifying Army General and Jingzhou Inspector Xie Hui was confirmed as Pacifying Army General and Jingzhou Inspector.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，司空、錄尚書事、揚州刺史徐羨之進位司徒，衞將軍、江州刺史王弘進位司空，中書監、護軍將軍傅亮加左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，撫軍將軍、荊州刺史謝晦進號衞將軍，鎮北將軍、南兗州刺史檀道濟進號征北將軍。

translations.literal: On guimao, Minister of Works, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, and Yangzhou Inspector Xu Xianzhi was promoted to Grand Commandant; General Who Guards the Army and Jiangzhou Inspector Wang Hong was promoted to Minister of Works; Director of the Palace Library and Protector of the Army Fu Liang was given the additional title of Left Grand Master of the Palace and Bearer of the Golden Battle-Ax, Opening Office with the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies; Pacifying Army General and Jingzhou Inspector Xie Hui was given the title General Who Guards the Army; General Who Pacifies the North and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Tan Daoji was given the title General Who Campaigns in the North.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Minister of Works, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, and Yangzhou Inspector Xu Xianzhi was promoted to Grand Commandant; General Who Guards the Army and Jiangzhou Inspector Wang Hong was promoted to Minister of Works; Director of the Palace Library and Protector of the Army Fu Liang was given the additional title of Left Grand Master of the Palace and Bearer of the Golden Battle-Ax, Opening Office with the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies; Pacifying Army General and Jingzhou Inspector Xie Hui was given the title General Who Guards the Army; General Who Pacifies the North and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Tan Daoji was given the title General Who Campaigns in the North.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，追尊所生胡婕妤為皇太后，諡曰章后。

translations.literal: On jiachen, his birth mother, Lady Hu the Talented Beauty, was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager with the posthumous title Empress Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, his birth mother, Lady Hu the Talented Beauty, was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager with the posthumous title Empress Zhang.

sentences.zh: 衞將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康進號驃騎將軍，冠軍將軍、南豫州刺史義恭進號撫軍將軍，封江夏王。

translations.literal: General Who Guards the Army and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was given the title General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief; General Who Conquers and Southern Yuzhou Inspector Yigong was given the title Pacifying Army General and enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Guards the Army and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was given the title General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief; General Who Conquers and Southern Yuzhou Inspector Yigong was given the title Pacifying Army General and enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 立第六皇弟義宣為竟陵王，第七皇弟義季為衡陽王。

translations.literal: The sixth younger imperial brother Yixuan was established as Prince of Jingling, and the seventh younger imperial brother Yiji as Prince of Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth younger imperial brother Yixuan was established as Prince of Jingling, and the seventh younger imperial brother Yiji as Prince of Hengyang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以豫州刺史劉粹為雍州刺史，驍騎將軍管義之為豫州刺史，南蠻校尉到彥之為中領軍。

translations.literal: On wushen, Yuzhou Inspector Liu Cui was made Yongzhou Inspector, General of Valiant Cavalry Guan Yizhi was made Yuzhou Inspector, and Colonel of the Southern Man Dao Yanzhi was made General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Yuzhou Inspector Liu Cui was made Yongzhou Inspector, General of Valiant Cavalry Guan Yizhi was made Yuzhou Inspector, and Colonel of the Southern Man Dao Yanzhi was made General of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 己酉，減荊、湘二州今年稅布之半。

translations.literal: On jiyou, this year’s cloth tax in Jing and Xiang provinces was reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, this year’s cloth tax in Jing and Xiang provinces was reduced by half.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，立妃袁氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On bingzi of the ninth month, Consort Yuan was established as Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of the ninth month, Consort Yuan was established as Empress.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙寅，司徒徐羨之、尚書令傅亮奉表歸政，上始親覽。

translations.literal: On bingyin of the first month of spring in year 2, Grand Commandant Xu Xianzhi and Director of the Masters of Writing Fu Liang submitted a memorial returning power to the throne, and the Emperor began to handle affairs personally.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin of the first month of spring in year 2, Grand Commandant Xu Xianzhi and Director of the Masters of Writing Fu Liang submitted a memorial returning power to the throne, and the Emperor began to handle affairs personally.

sentences.zh: 辛未，車駕祠南郊，[2]大赦天下。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the imperial carriage performed sacrifice at the southern suburban altar, and a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the imperial carriage performed sacrifice at the southern suburban altar, and a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，左將軍、徐州刺史王仲德進號安北將軍。

translations.literal: On yichou of the third month, General of the Left and Xuzhou Inspector Wang Zhongde was given the title General Who Pacifies the North.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the third month, General of the Left and Xuzhou Inspector Wang Zhongde was given the title General Who Pacifies the North.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊寅，特進謝澹卒。

translations.literal: In summer, on wuyin of the fifth month, Special Grand Master Xie Dan died.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on wuyin of the fifth month, Special Grand Master Xie Dan died.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲申，以關中流民出漢川，置京兆、扶風、馮翊等郡。

translations.literal: In autumn, on jiashen of the eighth month, because refugees from Guanzhong had left for the Han River region, the commanderies of Jingzhao, Fufeng, and Pingyi were established.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on jiashen of the eighth month, because refugees from Guanzhong had left for the Han River region, the commanderies of Jingzhao, Fufeng, and Pingyi were established.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，驃騎將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康為開府儀同三司，新除司空王弘為車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，以右軍長史江恒為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On yiyou, General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was given Opening Office with the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies; the newly appointed Minister of Works Wang Hong was made General of Chariots and Cavalry, Opening Office with the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies; Chief Clerk of the Right Army Jiang Heng was made Guangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was given Opening Office with the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies; the newly appointed Minister of Works Wang Hong was made General of Chariots and Cavalry, Opening Office with the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies; Chief Clerk of the Right Army Jiang Heng was made Guangzhou Inspector.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸酉，以前將軍楊玄為征西將軍、北秦州刺史。

translations.literal: In winter, on guiyou of the eleventh month, former General Yang Xuan was made General Who Campaigns in the West and Qinzhou Inspector of the North.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on guiyou of the eleventh month, former General Yang Xuan was made General Who Campaigns in the West and Qinzhou Inspector of the North.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙寅，司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史徐羨之，尚書令、護軍將軍、左光祿大夫傅亮，有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: On bingyin of the first month of spring in year 3, Grand Commandant, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, and Yangzhou Inspector Xu Xianzhi; Director of the Masters of Writing, Protector of the Army, and Left Grand Master of the Palace Fu Liang—having committed crimes—were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin of the first month of spring in year 3, Grand Commandant, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, and Yangzhou Inspector Xu Xianzhi, and Director of the Masters of Writing, Protector of the Army, and Left Grand Master of the Palace Fu Liang, having committed crimes, were executed.

sentences.zh: 遣中領軍到彥之、征北將軍檀道濟討荊州刺史謝晦，上親率六師西征。

translations.literal: General of the Central Army Dao Yanzhi and General Who Campaigns in the North Tan Daoji were sent to campaign against Jingzhou Inspector Xie Hui; the Emperor personally led the six armies on a western expedition.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Central Army Dao Yanzhi and General Who Campaigns in the North Tan Daoji were sent to campaign against Jingzhou Inspector Xie Hui; the Emperor personally led the six armies on a western expedition.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以車騎大將軍、江州刺史王弘為司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史，驃騎將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康改為荊州刺史，撫軍將軍、南豫州刺史江夏王義恭改為南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingmao, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Jiangzhou Inspector Wang Hong was made Grand Commandant, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, and Yangzhou Inspector; General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was changed to Jingzhou Inspector; Pacifying Army General and Southern Yuzhou Inspector Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was changed to Southern Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Jiangzhou Inspector Wang Hong was made Grand Commandant, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, and Yangzhou Inspector; General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was changed to Jingzhou Inspector; Pacifying Army General and Southern Yuzhou Inspector Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was changed to Southern Xuzhou Inspector.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以前護軍將軍趙倫之為鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: On jisi, former Protector of the Army Zhao Lunzhi was made General Who Guards the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, former Protector of the Army Zhao Lunzhi was made General Who Guards the Army.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙戌，皇子劭生。

translations.literal: On bingxu of the intercalary month, the imperial son Shao was born.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the intercalary month, the imperial son Shao was born.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，繫囚見徒，一皆原赦。

translations.literal: On yimao of the second month, all prisoners in custody and convicts in exile were entirely pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the second month, all prisoners in custody and convicts in exile were entirely pardoned.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以金紫光祿大夫王敬弘為尚書左僕射，豫章太守鄭鮮之為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Jinzi-guanglu Grand Master Wang Jinghong was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Zhangzhang Prefect Zheng Xianzhi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Jinzi-guanglu Grand Master Wang Jinghong was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Zhangzhang Prefect Zheng Xianzhi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 建安太守潘盛有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: Jian’an Prefect Pan Sheng, having committed a crime, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Jian’an Prefect Pan Sheng, having committed a crime, was executed.

sentences.zh: [3]庚申，特進范泰加光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Special Grand Master Fan Tai was given the additional title of Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Special Grand Master Fan Tai was given the additional title of Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 是日，車駕發京師。

translations.literal: That day, the imperial carriage set out from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That day, the imperial carriage set out from the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，到彥之、檀道濟大破謝晦於隱磯。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji inflicted a great defeat on Xie Hui at Yinji.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji inflicted a great defeat on Xie Hui at Yinji.

sentences.zh: 丙子，車駕自蕪湖反斾。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the imperial carriage turned its banners back from Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the imperial carriage turned its banners back from Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 己卯，擒晦於延頭，送京師伏誅。

translations.literal: On jimao, Hui was captured at Yantou and sent to the capital, where he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Hui was captured at Yantou and sent to the capital, where he was executed.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On xinsi of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙未，以征北將軍、南兗州刺史檀道濟為征南大將軍、江州刺史，中領軍到彥之為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In summer, on yiwei of the fifth month, General Who Campaigns in the North and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Tan Daoji was made General Who Campaigns in the South and Jiangzhou Inspector; General of the Central Army Dao Yanzhi was made Southern Yuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on yiwei of the fifth month, General Who Campaigns in the North and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Tan Daoji was made General Who Campaigns in the South and Jiangzhou Inspector; General of the Central Army Dao Yanzhi was made Southern Yuzhou Inspector.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以後將軍長沙王義欣為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Rear General Prince of Changsha Yixin was made Southern Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Rear General Prince of Changsha Yixin was made Southern Xuzhou Inspector.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，驃騎大將軍、涼州牧大沮渠蒙遜改為車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: On yisi, General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief and Liangzhou Governor Juqu Mengxun was changed to General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief and Liangzhou Governor Juqu Mengxun was changed to General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「夫哲王宰世，廣達四聰，猶巡嶽省方，採風觀政。

translations.literal: An edict said: "When a wise king governs the age, he broadly extends the four kinds of hearing, yet still tours the sacred mountains and inspects the regions, gathering the winds and observing government."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "When a wise king governs the age, he broadly extends the four kinds of hearing, yet still tours the sacred mountains and inspects the regions, gathering the winds and observing government."

sentences.zh: 所以情偽必審，幽遐罔滯，王澤無擁，九皐有聞者也。

translations.literal: Thus the true and false are surely examined, the remote and hidden are not neglected, royal favor is not blocked, and the nine marshes have those who hear.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the true and false are surely examined, the remote and hidden are not neglected, royal favor is not blocked, and the nine marshes have those who hear.

sentences.zh: 朕以寡薄，猥纂洪緒。

translations.literal: I, with my meager virtue, have unworthily inherited the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: I, with my meager virtue, have unworthily inherited the great enterprise.

sentences.zh: 雖永念治道，志存昧旦，願言傅巖，發想宵寐，而丘園之秀，藏器未臻，物情民隱，尚隔視聽。

translations.literal: Though I forever ponder the way of governance and keep my purpose at dawn, longing to speak of Fu Yue I rise from sleep at night—yet the worthy in hill and garden, their talents still unrevealed, and the people’s hidden hardships remain cut off from sight and hearing.
translations.idiomatic: Though I forever ponder the way of governance and keep my purpose at dawn, longing to speak of Fu Yue I rise from sleep at night—yet the worthy in hill and garden, their talents still unrevealed, and the people’s hidden hardships remain cut off from sight and hearing.

sentences.zh: 乃眷區域，輟寢忘飡。

translations.literal: Therefore I turn my regard to the regions and pause my rest, forgetting to eat.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore I turn my regard to the regions and pause my rest, forgetting to eat.

sentences.zh: 今氛祲袪蕩，宇內寧晏，旌賢弘化，於是乎始。

translations.literal: Now the baleful omens have been swept away, and within the four seas there is tranquility; to display the worthy and expand transformation begins from this moment.
translations.idiomatic: Now the baleful omens have been swept away, and within the four seas there is tranquility; to display the worthy and expand transformation begins from this moment.

sentences.zh: 可遣大使巡行四方。

translations.literal: Grand envoys may be dispatched to tour the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Grand envoys may be dispatched to tour the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 其宰守稱職之良，閨蓽一介之善，詳悉列奏，勿或有遺。

translations.literal: Those prefects and magistrates who are good at their duties, and every fine quality in humble cottage or byre, are to be reported in full detail in memorials—let nothing be omitted.
translations.idiomatic: Those prefects and magistrates who are good at their duties, and every fine quality in humble cottage or byre, are to be reported in full detail in memorials—let nothing be omitted.

sentences.zh: 若刑獄不卹，政治乖謬，傷民害教者，具以事聞。

translations.literal: If criminal cases are not relieved, if government is perverse and mistaken, or if the people are harmed and teaching injured, report the facts in full.
translations.idiomatic: If criminal cases are not relieved, if government is perverse and mistaken, or if the people are harmed and teaching injured, report the facts in full.

sentences.zh: 其高年、鰥寡、幼孤、六疾不能自存者，可與郡縣優量賑給。

translations.literal: Those of advanced age, widowers and widows, orphans and the young, and the six kinds of affliction who cannot support themselves may be given relief according to the best measure of the commandery and county.
translations.idiomatic: Those of advanced age, widowers and widows, orphans and the young, and the six kinds of affliction who cannot support themselves may be given relief according to the best measure of the commandery and county.

sentences.zh: 博採輿誦，廣納嘉謀，務盡銜命之旨，俾若朕親覽焉。

translations.literal: Broadly gather popular songs, widely receive excellent counsel, and exhaust the intent of those bearing the mandate, as if I myself were viewing it.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly gather popular songs, widely receive excellent counsel, and exhaust the intent of those bearing the mandate, as if I myself were viewing it.

sentences.zh: 」丙午，車駕臨延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the imperial carriage attended at the Hall for Honoring the Worthy to hear litigation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the imperial carriage attended at the Hall for Honoring the Worthy to hear litigation.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，以鎮軍將軍趙倫之為左光祿大夫、領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On jiwei of the sixth month, General Who Guards the Army Zhao Lunzhi was made Left Grand Master of the Palace and General of the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the sixth month, General Who Guards the Army Zhao Lunzhi was made Left Grand Master of the Palace and General of the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，車駕又於延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the imperial carriage again attended at the Hall for Honoring the Worthy to hear litigation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the imperial carriage again attended at the Hall for Honoring the Worthy to hear litigation.

sentences.zh: 丙子，又聽訟。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he again heard litigation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, he again heard litigation.

sentences.zh: 以右衞王華為中護軍。

translations.literal: General of the Right Guard Wang Hua was made General of the Central Guard.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Right Guard Wang Hua was made General of the Central Guard.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊寅，以梁、南秦二州刺史吉翰為益州刺史，驃騎參軍劉道產為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: In winter, on wuyin of the eleventh month, Liang and Southern Qin Inspector Ji Han was made Yizhou Inspector, and Staff Officer of the General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief Liu Daochan was made Liang and Southern Qin Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on wuyin of the eleventh month, Liang and Southern Qin Inspector Ji Han was made Yizhou Inspector, and Staff Officer of the General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief Liu Daochan was made Liang and Southern Qin Inspector.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以南蠻校尉劉遵考為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On jihai, Colonel of the Southern Man Liu Zunkao was made Yongzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Colonel of the Southern Man Liu Zunkao was made Yongzhou Inspector.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，以中書侍郎蕭思話為青州刺史。

translations.literal: On guichou of the twelfth month, Attendant of the Palace Library Xiao Sihua was made Qingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou of the twelfth month, Attendant of the Palace Library Xiao Sihua was made Qingzhou Inspector.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，前吳郡太守徐佩之謀反，及黨與皆伏誅。

translations.literal: On renxu, former Wu Prefect Xu Peizhi plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, former Wu Prefect Xu Peizhi plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all executed.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月乙亥朔，曲赦都邑百里內。

translations.literal: On yihai, the new moon of the first month of spring in year 4, a partial amnesty was proclaimed within one hundred li of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the new moon of the first month of spring in year 4, a partial amnesty was proclaimed within one hundred li of the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the imperial carriage personally performed sacrifice at the southern suburban altar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the imperial carriage personally performed sacrifice at the southern suburban altar.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，行幸丹徒，謁京陵。

translations.literal: On yimao of the second month, he traveled to Dantu and paid respects at the Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the second month, he traveled to Dantu and paid respects at the Jing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，詔曰：「丹徒桑梓綢繆，大業攸始，踐境永懷，觸感罔極。

translations.literal: On bingzi of the third month, an edict said: "Dantu is bound to me by ties of native place; the great enterprise began from there. Treading that soil, my feelings are everlasting; touched by it, my emotion knows no limit."
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of the third month, an edict said: "Dantu is bound to me by ties of native place; the great enterprise began from there. Treading that soil, my feelings are everlasting; touched by it, my emotion knows no limit."

sentences.zh: 昔漢章南巡，加恩元氏，況情義二三，有兼曩日。

translations.literal: Formerly Emperor Zhang of Han on his southern tour added favor to the Yuan clan; how much more when affection and obligation are doubled or tripled, as in days past.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Emperor Zhang of Han on his southern tour added favor to the Yuan clan; how much more when affection and obligation are doubled or tripled, as in days past.

sentences.zh: 思播遺澤，酬慰士民。

translations.literal: I wish to spread lingering bounty and repay and comfort the gentry and people.
translations.idiomatic: I wish to spread lingering bounty and repay and comfort the gentry and people.

sentences.zh: 其蠲此縣今年租布，五歲刑以下皆悉原遣；

translations.literal: This county’s rent and cloth for this year are to be remitted; all punishments of five years or less are entirely pardoned and released.
translations.idiomatic: This county’s rent and cloth for this year are to be remitted; all punishments of five years or less are entirely pardoned and released.

sentences.zh: 登城三戰及大將家，隨宜隱卹。

translations.literal: Those who fought three battles in the assault on the city and the households of great generals are to receive condolence and relief as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Those who fought three battles in the assault on the city and the households of great generals are to receive condolence and relief as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 」丁亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊子，尚書右僕射鄭鮮之卒。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Zheng Xianzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Zheng Xianzhi died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，禁斷夏至日五絲命縷之屬，富陽令諸葛闡之之議也。

translations.literal: On renyin, the use on the summer solstice of five-colored silk life-cords and the like was forbidden—this was the proposal of Fuyang Magistrate Zhuge Kan.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the use on the summer solstice of five-colored silk life-cords and the like was forbidden—this was the proposal of Fuyang Magistrate Zhuge Kan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，以廷尉王徽之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In summer, on gengxu of the fourth month, Director of the Court of Justice Wang Huizhi was made Jiaozhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on gengxu of the fourth month, Director of the Court of Justice Wang Huizhi was made Jiaozhou Inspector.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，中護軍王華卒。

translations.literal: On renwu of the fifth month, General of the Central Guard Wang Hua died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the fifth month, General of the Central Guard Wang Hua died.

sentences.zh: 京師疾疫，甲午，遣使存問，給醫藥；

translations.literal: An epidemic struck the capital; on jiawu, envoys were sent to inquire after the people and provide medicine.
translations.idiomatic: An epidemic struck the capital; on jiawu, envoys were sent to inquire after the people and provide medicine.

sentences.zh: 死者若無家屬，賜以棺器。

translations.literal: If the dead had no family, coffins and burial goods were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: If the dead had no family, coffins and burial goods were bestowed.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On guimao, the new moon of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the new moon of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以金紫光祿大夫殷穆為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Jinzi-guanglu Grand Master Yin Mu was made Protector of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Jinzi-guanglu Grand Master Yin Mu was made Protector of the Army.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙亥，詔曰：「朕恭承洪業，臨饗四海，風化未弘，治道多昧，求之人事，鑒寐惟憂。

translations.literal: On yihai of the first month of spring in year 5, an edict said: "I respectfully receive the great enterprise and preside over feasting for the four seas; custom and transformation are not yet broadly spread, and the way of governance has many obscurities. Seeking it in human affairs, in waking and sleeping alike there is only worry."
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the first month of spring in year 5, an edict said: "I respectfully receive the great enterprise and preside over feasting for the four seas; custom and transformation are not yet broadly spread, and the way of governance has many obscurities. Seeking it in human affairs, in waking and sleeping alike there is only worry."

sentences.zh: 加頃陰陽違序，旱疫成患，仰惟災戒，責深在予。

translations.literal: Moreover, yin and yang have lately been out of order, drought and plague have become calamities; looking up at these disaster warnings, the blame lies deep in me.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, yin and yang have lately been out of order, drought and plague have become calamities; looking up at these disaster warnings, the blame lies deep in me.

sentences.zh: 思所以側身剋念，議獄詳刑，上答天譴，下恤民瘼。

translations.literal: I think how to turn my person and restrain my thoughts, deliberate on punishments and examine penalties, to answer Heaven’s reproof above and comfort the people’s afflictions below.
translations.idiomatic: I think how to turn my person and restrain my thoughts, deliberate on punishments and examine penalties, to answer Heaven’s reproof above and comfort the people’s afflictions below.

sentences.zh: 羣后百司，其各獻讜言，指陳得失，勿有所諱。

translations.literal: All the hosts of ministers and the hundred offices are each to present loyal words, pointing out gains and losses—let nothing be concealed.
translations.idiomatic: All the hosts of ministers and the hundred offices are each to present loyal words, pointing out gains and losses—let nothing be concealed.

sentences.zh: 」甲申，車駕臨玄武館閱武。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the imperial carriage attended at the Black Tortoise Hall to review the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the imperial carriage attended at the Black Tortoise Hall to review the troops.

sentences.zh: 戊子，京邑大火，遣使巡慰賑賜。

translations.literal: On wuzi, a great fire broke out in the capital; envoys were sent to tour, comfort, and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, a great fire broke out in the capital; envoys were sent to tour, comfort, and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，以南蠻校尉蕭摹之為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: In summer, on jihai of the fourth month, Colonel of the Southern Man Xiao Muzhi was made Xiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on jihai of the fourth month, Colonel of the Southern Man Xiao Muzhi was made Xiangzhou Inspector.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以始興太守徐豁為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Shixing Prefect Xu Huo was made Guangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Shixing Prefect Xu Huo was made Guangzhou Inspector.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，以湘州刺史張邵為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On jimao of the fifth month, Xiangzhou Inspector Zhang Shao was made Yongzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao, Xiangzhou Inspector Zhang Shao was appointed Yongzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，司徒王弘降為衞將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On gengxu of the sixth month, Grand Commandant Wang Hong was reduced to General Who Guards the Army, Opening Office with the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu of the sixth month, Grand Commandant Wang Hong was demoted to General Who Guards the Army with Opening Office equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 京邑大水，乙卯，[4]遣使檢行賑贍。

translations.literal: The capital suffered great flooding; on yimao, [4] envoys were sent to inspect and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: After great floods in the capital, on yimao [4] envoys were dispatched to inspect the damage and distribute relief.

sentences.zh: 以江夏內史程道惠為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: Jiangxia Interior Administrator Cheng Daohui was made Guangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxia interior administrator Cheng Daohui was appointed Guangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬戌，特進、左光祿大夫范泰卒。

translations.literal: In autumn, on renxu of the eighth month, Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace Fan Tai died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on renxu, Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace Fan Tai died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，車駕於延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: In winter, on jiachen of the tenth month, the imperial carriage attended at the Hall for Honoring the Worthy to hear litigation.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen, the emperor heard cases at the Hall for Honoring the Worthy.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸未，以右軍司馬劉德武為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On guimao of the intercalary month, Chief Clerk of the Right Army Liu Dewu was made Yuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on guimao, Chief Clerk of the Right Army Liu Dewu was made Yuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，安陸公相周籍之為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Chancellor of the Duchy of Anling Zhou Jizhi was made Ningzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Chancellor of the Duchy of Anling Zhou Jizhi was appointed Ningzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，左光祿大夫、領軍將軍趙倫之卒。

translations.literal: On gengyin of the twelfth month, Left Grand Master of the Palace and General of the Palace Guard Zhao Lunzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the twelfth month, Left Grand Master of the Palace and General of the Palace Guard Zhao Lunzhi died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天竺國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year, the state of Tianzhu sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys from Tianzhu (India) arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛丑，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: On xinchou of the first month of spring in year 6, the imperial carriage personally performed sacrifice at the southern suburban altar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the first month of spring, year 6, the emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburban altar.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以驃騎將軍、荊州刺史彭城王義康為司徒、錄尚書事，領平北將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On guichou, General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief and Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was made Grand Commandant, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, and concurrently General Who Pacifies the North and Southern Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief and Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang became Grand Commandant and Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, while retaining the posts of General Who Pacifies the North and Southern Xuzhou inspector.

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，立皇子劭為皇太子。

translations.literal: On dingsi of the third month, the imperial son Shao was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the third month, Prince Shao was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大赦天下，賜文武位一等。

translations.literal: On wuwu, a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire, and civil and military officials were granted one rank in status.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu a general amnesty was declared and civil and military officials advanced one rank.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以左衞將軍殷景仁為中領軍。

translations.literal: On xinyou, General of the Left Guard Yin Jingren was made General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, General of the Left Guard Yin Jingren was appointed General of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，以尚書左僕射王敬弘為尚書令，丹陽尹臨川王義慶為尚書左僕射，吏部尚書江夷為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In summer, on guihai of the fourth month, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Jinghong was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Governor of Danyang and Prince of Linchuan Yiqing was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Director of the Ministry of Personnel Jiang Yi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guihai, Left Vice Director Wang Jinghong became Director of the Masters of Writing; Danyang governor Prince of Linchuan Yiqing became Left Vice Director; and Director of Personnel Jiang Yi became Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On renchen, the new moon of the fifth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the new moon of the fifth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以新除尚書令王敬弘為特進、左光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On guisi, the newly appointed Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Jinghong was made Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the newly appointed Director Wang Jinghong was given the additional titles of Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以撫軍司馬劉道濟為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Chief Clerk of the Pacifying Army Liu Daoji was made Yizhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Chief Clerk of the Pacifying Army Liu Daoji was appointed Yizhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，於雍州置馮翊郡。

translations.literal: On yimao, the commandery of Pingyi was established in Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the commandery of Pingyi was established within Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 七月己酉，以尚書左丞孔默之為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiyou of the seventh month, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Kong Mozhi was made Guangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiyou, Left Vice Director Kong Mozhi was made Guangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 是月，百濟王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That month, the king of Baekje sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: That month the king of Baekje sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，於秦州置隴西、宋康二郡。

translations.literal: On wuwu of the ninth month, the commanderies of Longxi and Songkang were established in Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu of the ninth month, Longxi and Songkang commanderies were set up in Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申，中領軍殷景仁丁艱去職。

translations.literal: In winter, on renshen of the tenth month, General of the Central Army Yin Jingren left office on account of mourning for his parent.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renshen, General of the Central Army Yin Jingren resigned to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On jichou, the new moon of the eleventh month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the new moon of the eleventh month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，河南國、河西王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On dinghai of the twelfth month, the state of Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai of the twelfth month, Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys with tribute.

translations.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月癸巳，以吐谷渾慕容璝為征西將軍、沙州刺史。

translations.literal: On guisi of the first month of spring in year 7, Murong Gui of Tuyuhun was made General Who Campaigns in the West and Shazhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the first month of spring, year 7, Murong Gui of Tuyuhun was made General Who Campaigns in the West and inspector of Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，倭國王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That month, the king of Wa sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: That month the king of Wa (Japan) sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，遣右將軍到彥之北伐，水軍入河。

translations.literal: On wuzi of the third month, General of the Right Dao Yanzhi was sent on a northern campaign; the navy entered the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the third month, General of the Right Dao Yanzhi marched north while the fleet entered the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以前征虜司馬尹沖為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiawu, former Chief Clerk for Campaigning against Barbarians Yin Chong was made Sizhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, former Chief Clerk for Campaigning against Barbarians Yin Chong was appointed Sizhou inspector.

sentences.zh: [7]甲寅，以前中領軍殷景仁為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: [7] On jiayin, former General of the Central Army Yin Jingren was made General of the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: [7] On jiayin, former General of the Central Army Yin Jingren was restored as General of the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，訶羅單國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On guiwei of the fourth month of summer, the state of Heluodan sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guiwei, Heluodan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，以冠軍將軍氐楊難當為秦州刺史。

translations.literal: On jimao of the sixth month, General Who Conquers Yang Nachang of the Di was made Qinzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the sixth month, General Who Conquers Yang Nachang of the Di was made Qinzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，索虜碻磝戍棄城走。

translations.literal: In autumn, on wuzi of the seventh month, the Northern Wei garrison at Quepo abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuzi, the Northern Wei garrison at Quepo abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以平北諮議參軍甄法護為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Pacifying-the-North Staff Officer Zhen Fahu was made Liang and Southern Qin Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Pacifying-the-North staff officer Zhen Fahu was appointed inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，索虜滑臺戍棄城走。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the Northern Wei garrison at Huatai abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the Northern Wei garrison at Huatai abandoned the city and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，林邑國、訶羅陁國、師子國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the states of Linyi, Heluotuo, and Shizi sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Linyi, Heluotuo, and Shizi each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，罷南豫州并豫州。

translations.literal: On jiayin of the tenth month of winter, Southern Yuzhou was abolished and merged into Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the tenth month of winter, Southern Yuzhou was abolished and absorbed into Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 以左將軍竟陵王義宣為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: General of the Left and Prince of Jingling Yixuan was made Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Left Prince of Jingling Yixuan was appointed Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 戊午，立錢署，鑄四銖錢。

translations.literal: On wuwu, a mint was established to cast four-zhu coins.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu a government mint was established to cast four-zhu coins.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，金墉城為索虜所陷。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Jincheng city was taken by the Northern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Jincheng fell to the Northern Wei.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，虎牢城復為索虜所陷。

translations.literal: On guimao of the eleventh month, Hulao city was again taken by the Northern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the eleventh month, Hulao was lost again to the Northern Wei.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣征南大將軍檀道濟北討，右將軍到彥之自滑臺奔退。

translations.literal: On renchen, General Who Campaigns in the South Tan Daoji was sent on a northern punitive expedition, and General of the Right Dao Yanzhi fled in retreat from Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen General Who Campaigns in the South Tan Daoji marched north on campaign, while General of the Right Dao Yanzhi retreated in disorder from Huatai.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，以南兗州刺史長沙王義欣為豫州刺史，司徒司馬吉翰為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinyou of the twelfth month, Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Changsha Yixin was made Yuzhou Inspector, and Grand Commandant Staff Officer Ji Han was made Sizhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of the twelfth month, Southern Xuzhou inspector Prince of Changsha Yixin became Yuzhou inspector, and Grand Commandant staff officer Ji Han became Sizhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，京邑火，延燒太社北牆。

translations.literal: On yihai, fire broke out in the capital and spread to burn the north wall of the Grand Temple of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai a great fire in the capital spread to the north wall of the Grand Temple of Soil and Grain.

sentences.zh: 兗州刺史竺靈秀有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: Yanzhou Inspector Zhu Lingxiu, having committed a crime, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou Inspector Zhu Lingxiu, convicted of a crime, was executed.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月庚寅，於交州復立珠崖郡。

translations.literal: On gengyin of the first month of spring in year 8, Zhuyai Commandery was re-established in Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the first month of spring, year 8, Zhuyai Commandery was re-established in Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以左軍將軍申宣為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On guisi, General of the Left Army Shen Xuan was made Yanzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, General of the Left Army Shen Xuan was appointed Yanzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，征南大將軍檀道濟破索虜於東平壽張。

translations.literal: On dingyou, General Who Campaigns in the South Tan Daoji defeated the Northern Wei at Dongping Shouzhang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou General Who Campaigns in the South Tan Daoji defeated the Northern Wei at Dongping Shouzhang.

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，以平北司馬韋朗為青州刺史。

translations.literal: On yimao of the second month, Chief Clerk of the Pacifying-the-North Army Wei Lang was made Qingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the second month, Chief Clerk of the Pacifying-the-North Army Wei Lang was made Qingzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以尚書右僕射江夷為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Jiang Yi was made Xiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Right Vice Director Jiang Yi was appointed Xiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，滑臺為索虜所陷。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Huatai was taken by the Northern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Huatai fell to the Northern Wei.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，征南大將軍檀道濟引軍還。

translations.literal: On guiyou, General Who Campaigns in the South Tan Daoji led his army back.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou General Who Campaigns in the South Tan Daoji withdrew his army.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，青州刺史蕭思話棄城走。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Qingzhou Inspector Xiao Sihua abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Qingzhou Inspector Xiao Sihua abandoned his post and fled.

sentences.zh: 以太子右衞率劉遵考為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: Leader of the Right Guard of the Heir Apparent Liu Zunkao was made Southern Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Leader of the Heir Apparent’s Right Guard Liu Zunkao was appointed Southern Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，車駕於延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On jiashen of the third month, the imperial carriage attended at the Hall for Honoring the Worthy to hear litigation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the third month, the emperor again heard cases at the Hall for Honoring the Worthy.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔曰：「自頃軍役殷興，國用增廣，資儲不給，百度尚繁。

translations.literal: On wushen, an edict said: "Recently military service has been frequent and state expenses have increased; resources and stores are insufficient, and the hundred administrations remain burdensome."
translations.idiomatic: On wushen an edict declared: "Military campaigns have lately multiplied and state expenses have grown; stores are insufficient and administration remains heavy."

sentences.zh: 宜存簡約，以應事實。

translations.literal: Simplicity should be preserved to meet actual needs.
translations.idiomatic: Let simplicity be preserved to match real needs.

sentences.zh: 內外可通共詳思，務令節儉。」

translations.literal: Within and without, all may jointly deliberate in detail and strive to achieve frugality."
translations.idiomatic: Within and without the court, let all deliberate together and strive for frugality."

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，以衡陽王師阮萬齡為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiayin of the fourth month of summer, Prince of Hengyang Shiyuan Wanling was made Xiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin, Prince of Hengyang Shiyuan Wanling was made Xiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以後軍參軍徐遵之為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On yimao, Rear Army Staff Officer Xu Zunzhi was made Yanzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Rear Army staff officer Xu Zunzhi was appointed Yanzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On yichou of the sixth month, a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the sixth month a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，割江南及揚州晉陵郡屬南徐州，江北屬兗州。

translations.literal: On jimao, the region south of the Yangtze and Jingling Commandery of Yang Province were attached to Southern Xuzhou; the region north of the Yangtze was attached to Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao lands south of the Yangtze and Jingling Commandery in Yang Province were placed under Southern Xuzhou, while the north bank was placed under Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 以徐州刺史竟陵王義宣為南兗州刺史，司徒司馬吉翰為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Jingling Yixuan was made Southern Xuzhou Inspector, and Grand Commandant Staff Officer Ji Han was made Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Xuzhou inspector Prince of Jingling Yixuan became Southern Xuzhou inspector, and Grand Commandant staff officer Ji Han became Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚子，詔曰：「自頃農桑惰業，遊食者眾，荒萊不闢，督課無聞。

translations.literal: On gengzi of the intercalary month, an edict said: "Recently agriculture and sericulture have grown slack, and those who wander for food are many; wasteland is not opened, and supervision of tax quotas goes unheard."
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi of the intercalary month an edict said: "Agriculture and sericulture have lately grown slack; wanderers are many, wasteland lies unopened, and tax supervision goes unheard."

sentences.zh: 一時水旱，便有罄匱，苟不深存務本，[9]豐給靡因。

translations.literal: When flood and drought come in a season, destitution follows at once; if we do not deeply preserve the fundamental task, [9] abundance and supply will have no source.
translations.idiomatic: When flood or drought strike in a season, want follows at once; unless the fundamental task is deeply preserved, [9] abundance will have no foundation.

sentences.zh: 郡守賦政方畿，縣宰親民之主，宜思奬訓，導以良規。

translations.literal: Prefects administer government in the capital region; magistrates are the lords who are close to the people—they should think how to encourage and instruct and guide them with good rules.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects govern the capital region; magistrates are masters close to the people—they should encourage and instruct and guide them with sound rules.

sentences.zh: 咸使肆力，地無遺利，耕蠶樹藝，各盡其力。

translations.literal: All are to make them exert their strength so that the land has no unused benefit, and in plowing, sericulture, planting, and cultivation each exhausts his capacity.
translations.idiomatic: Let all be made to exert their strength so the land yields fully, and in plowing, sericulture, planting, and cultivation each gives his utmost.

sentences.zh: 若有力田殊眾，歲竟條名列上。

translations.literal: If any have outstanding strength in farming, at year’s end list them by item and report upward."
translations.idiomatic: Those with exceptional success in farming are to be listed in detail and reported upward at year’s end."

sentences.zh: 」揚州旱。

translations.literal: Yang Province suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Province suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣侍御史省獄訟，申調役。

translations.literal: On yisi, attendant censors were sent to review prison cases and adjust corvée labor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi attendant censors were sent to review prison cases and adjust corvée duties.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以左軍諮議參軍劉道產為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Pacifying-the-Army Staff Officer Liu Daochan was made Yongzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Pacifying-the-Army staff officer Liu Daochan was appointed Yongzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲辰，臨川王義慶解尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On jiachen of the eighth month of autumn, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing resigned as Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the eighth month, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing resigned as Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丁未，割豫州秦郡屬南兗州。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Qin Commandery of Yuzhou was attached to Southern Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Qin Commandery in Yuzhou was transferred to Southern Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，罷湘州還并荊州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, Xiang Province was abolished and merged back into Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, Xiang Province was abolished and merged back into Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 九年春三月庚戌，衞將軍王弘進位太保，加中書監。

translations.literal: On gengxu of the third month of spring in year 9, General Who Guards the Army Wang Hong was promoted to Grand Preceptor and given the additional post of Director of the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the third month of spring, year 9, General Who Guards the Army Wang Hong was promoted to Grand Preceptor with the additional post of Director of the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，征南大將軍、江州刺史檀道濟進位司空。

translations.literal: On dingsi, General Who Campaigns in the South and Jiangzhou Inspector Tan Daoji was promoted to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, General Who Campaigns in the South and Jiangzhou Inspector Tan Daoji was promoted to Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，以護軍將軍殷穆為特進、右光祿大夫，建昌縣公到彥之為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On yihai of the fourth month of summer, Protector of the Army Yin Mu was made Special Grand Master and Right Grand Master of the Palace; Marquis of Jianchang Dao Yanzhi was made Protector of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yihai, Protector of the Army Yin Mu became Special Grand Master and Right Grand Master of the Palace, and Marquis of Jianchang Dao Yanzhi became Protector of the Army.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，中書監、錄尚書事、衞將軍、揚州刺史王弘薨。

translations.literal: On renshen of the fifth month, Director of the Palace Library, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, General Who Guards the Army, and Yangzhou Inspector Wang Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen of the fifth month, Director of the Palace Library, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, General Who Guards the Army, and Yangzhou Inspector Wang Hong died.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，以左軍諮議參軍申宣為青州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiaxu of the sixth month, Pacifying-the-Army Staff Officer Shen Xuan was made Qingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Pacifying-the-Army staff officer Shen Xuan was appointed Qingzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 分青州置冀州。

translations.literal: Ji Province was established by partitioning Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Province was carved out of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，司徒、南徐州刺史彭城王義康改領揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Grand Commandant and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was changed to hold Yangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Grand Commandant and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang took over as Yangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以司徒參軍崔諲為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On jimao, Grand Commandant Staff Officer Cui Yin was made Jizhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Grand Commandant staff officer Cui Yin was appointed Jizhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以吐谷渾慕容延為平東將軍，[10]吐谷渾拾虔為平北將軍，吐谷渾輝伐為鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: On renwu, Murong Yan of Tuyuhun was made General Who Pacifies the East, [10] Murong Shiqian of Tuyuhun was made General Who Pacifies the North, and Murong Huifa of Tuyuhun was made General Who Guards the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Murong Yan of Tuyuhun was made General Who Pacifies the East, [10] Murong Shiqian General Who Pacifies the North, and Murong Huifa General Who Guards the Army.

sentences.zh: [11]癸未，詔曰：「益、梁、交、廣，境域幽遐，治宜物情，或多偏擁。

translations.literal: [11] On guimao, an edict said: "Yi, Liang, Jiao, and Guang—their territories are remote and far; governance should suit local conditions, yet many are partial and overbearing."
translations.idiomatic: [11] On guimao an edict said: "Yi, Liang, Jiao, and Guang lie in distant borderlands; governance must suit local conditions, yet many officials rule with partial harshness."

sentences.zh: 可更遣大使，巡求民瘼。

translations.literal: Grand envoys may again be dispatched to tour and seek the people’s afflictions."
translations.idiomatic: Grand envoys are again to be sent to tour the regions and investigate the people’s hardships."

sentences.zh: 」置積射、強弩將軍官。

translations.literal: The offices of General of Strong Archers and General of Powerful Crossbows were established.
translations.idiomatic: The posts of General of Strong Archers and General of Powerful Crossbows were established.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以征西將軍、沙州刺史吐谷渾慕容璝為征西大將軍、西秦河二州刺史、隴西王。

translations.literal: On yiwei, General Who Campaigns in the West and Shazhou Inspector Murong Gui of Tuyuhun was made General Who Campaigns in the West Grand Marshal, Inspector of Xi-Qin-He, and King of Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, General Who Campaigns in the West and Shazhou Inspector Murong Gui of Tuyuhun was promoted to Grand Marshal campaigning in the west, made inspector of Xi, Qin, and He, and enfeoffed as King of Longxi.

sentences.zh: 北秦州刺史氐楊難當加號征西將軍。

translations.literal: Qinzhou Inspector of the North Yang Nachang of the Di was given the additional title General Who Campaigns in the West.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qinzhou inspector Yang Nachang of the Di was given the additional title General Who Campaigns in the West.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以撫軍將軍、荊州刺史江夏王義恭為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史，前將軍臨川王義慶為平西將軍、荊州刺史，南兗州刺史竟陵王義宣為中書監、中軍將軍，征虜將軍衡陽王義季為南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On renyin, Pacifying Army General and Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was made General Who Campaigns in the North, Opening Office with the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies, and Southern Xuzhou Inspector; former General Qian Prince of Linchuan Yiqing was made General Who Pacifies the West and Jingzhou Inspector; Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Jingling Yixuan was made Director of the Palace Library and General of the Central Army; General Who Campaigns against Barbarians Prince of Hengyang Yiji was made Southern Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Pacifying Army General and Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Jiangxia Yigong became General Who Campaigns in the North with Opening Office equal to the Three Excellencies and Southern Xuzhou inspector; former General Qian Prince of Linchuan Yiqing became General Who Pacifies the West and Jingzhou inspector; Southern Xuzhou inspector Prince of Jingling Yixuan became Director of the Palace Library and General of the Central Army; and General Who Campaigns against Barbarians Prince of Hengyang Yiji became Southern Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，以尚書王仲德為鎮北將軍、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuchen of the seventh month of autumn, Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Zhongde was made General Who Guards the North and Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuchen, Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Zhongde was made General Who Guards the North and Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以領軍將軍殷景仁為尚書僕射，太子詹事劉湛為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu, General of the Palace Guard Yin Jingren was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Tutor of the Heir Apparent Liu Zhan was made General of the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, General of the Palace Guard Yin Jingren became Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Tutor of the Heir Apparent Liu Zhan became General of the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 壬申，河南國、河西王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On renshen, the state of Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys with tribute.

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.

sentences.zh: 九月，妖賊趙廣寇益州，陷沒郡縣，州府討平之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the demonic bandit Zhao Guang raided Yizhou, overran and captured commanderies and counties, and the provincial government suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the rebel Zhao Guang raided Yizhou, seized commanderies and counties, and was suppressed by the provincial government.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬子，以少府甄法崇為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On renzi of the eleventh month of winter, Director of the Palace Treasury Zhen Fachong was made Yizhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi of the eleventh month, Director of the Palace Treasury Zhen Fachong was appointed Yizhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，於廣州立宋康郡。

translations.literal: On guichou, Songkang Commandery was established in Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Songkang Commandery was established in Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，以右軍參軍李秀之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, Li Xiuzhi, Staff Officer of the Right Army, was made Jiao Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu of the twelfth month, Right Army staff officer Li Xiuzhi was appointed inspector of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，立第五皇子紹為廬陵王，江夏王義恭子朗為南豐縣王。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the fifth imperial son Shao was established as Prince of Luling, and Lang, son of Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, as Prince of Nanfeng County.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the fifth prince, Shao, was enfeoffed as Prince of Luling, and Lang, son of Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, as prince of Nanfeng county.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月甲寅，竟陵王義宣改封南譙王。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the tenth year, on jiayin, Prince of Jingling Yixuan was changed in enfeoffment to Prince of Nanqiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, on jiayin of the first spring month, Prince of Jingling Yixuan was redesignated Prince of Nanqiao.

sentences.zh: 鎮北將軍、徐州刺史王仲德加領兗州刺史，淮南太守段宏為青州刺史。

translations.literal: Wang Zhongde, Pacifying-North General and Xu Province Inspector, was additionally made Yan Province Inspector; Duan Hong, Administrator of Huainan, was made Qing Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying-North general Wang Zhongde, already inspector of Xu, was also given Yan Province; Huainan administrator Duan Hong became inspector of Qing.

sentences.zh: 己未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On jiwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the court proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 孤老、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: Orphans and the aged living alone, and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves, were each granted five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Each orphan or elderly person living alone, and anyone disabled by the six infirmities who could not support himself, received five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 後將軍、豫州刺史長沙王義欣進號鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: Yixin, Prince of Changsha, General of the Rear and Yu Province Inspector, was advanced in title to General of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Changsha Yixin, rear general and inspector of Yu, was promoted to General of the Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，青州刺史段宏加冀州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on wuxu, Qing Province Inspector Duan Hong was additionally made Ji Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In summer’s fourth month, on wuxu, Qing inspector Duan Hong was also given Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 封陽縣侯蕭思話為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: Marquis of Fengyang County Xiao Sihua was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Sihua, Marquis of Fengyang County, was appointed inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 五月，林邑王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the king of Linyi sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the king of Linyi (Champa) sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，以前青州刺史韋朗為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yihai, former Qing Province Inspector Wei Lang was made Guang Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the sixth month, former Qing inspector Wei Lang was made inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: 闍婆州訶羅單國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The state of Heluodan in Campa sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Heluodan in Campa sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，曲赦益、梁、秦三州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuxu, a partial amnesty was granted in Yi, Liang, and Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the seventh autumn month, Yi, Liang, and Qin received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 於益州立宋寧、宋興二郡。

translations.literal: The commanderies of Songning and Songxing were established in Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Province gained two new commanderies, Songning and Songxing.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，於青州立太原郡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingchou, Taiyuan Commandery was established in Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the eighth month Taiyuan Commandery was set up within Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，護軍將軍到彥之卒。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Protector of the Army Dao Yanzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Dao Yanzhi, Protector of the Army, passed away.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，氐楊難當寇漢川。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, the Di chieftain Yang Nadu raided Hanzhuan.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month, the Di leader Yang Nadu attacked Hanzhuan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，梁州刺史甄法護棄城走，難當據有梁州。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Liang Province Inspector Zhen Fahu abandoned the city and fled; Nadu seized Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Liang inspector Zhen Fahu abandoned his post and fled, and Nadu took possession of Liang.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月，亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山，[13]州郡討平之。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the eleventh year, the outlaw Ma Daxuan and his band of several hundred men raided Mount Tai; [13] the province and commanderies suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year’s first spring month, the fugitive Ma Daxuan led several hundred followers in a raid on Mount Tai; [13] provincial and commandery forces suppressed and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，以交阯太守李耽之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guiyou, Jiaozhi Administrator Li Danzhi was made Jiao Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the second month, Jiaozhi administrator Li Danzhi became inspector of Jiao.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，梁、秦二州刺史蕭思話破氐楊難當，梁州平。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Liang and Southern Qin Inspector Xiao Sihua defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nadu, and Liang Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In summer’s fourth month Xiao Sihua, inspector of Liang and Southern Qin, defeated the Di leader Yang Nadu and restored order in Liang.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，曲赦梁、南秦二州劍閣北。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingmao, a partial amnesty was granted in Liang and Southern Qin provinces north of Jian’ge Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the fifth month a partial amnesty was declared for Liang and Southern Qin north of Jian’ge.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以大沮渠茂虔為征西大將軍、涼州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Juqu Maoqian of Northern Liang was made Campaigning-West Grand General and Liang Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Juqu Maoqian of Northern Liang was appointed Grand General campaigning west and inspector of Liang.

sentences.zh: 是月，京邑大水。

translations.literal: That month the capital suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That month severe floods struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，省魏郡。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingwei, Wei Commandery was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei of the sixth month Wei Commandery was abolished.

sentences.zh: 是歲，林邑國、扶南國、訶羅單國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year Linyi, Funan, and Heluodan sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys from Linyi, Funan, and Heluodan arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月辛酉，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twelfth year, on xinyou, a general amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the twelfth year’s first spring month the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 辛未，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the imperial carriage personally performed sacrifice at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburban altar.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，封黃龍國主馮弘為燕王。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Feng Hong, ruler of the Yellow Dragon state, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Feng Hong of the Yellow Dragon state received the enfeoffment of Prince of Yan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，[14]尚書僕射殷景仁加中護軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou, [14] Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yin Jingren was additionally made General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: In summer’s fourth month, on yiyou, [14] Masters of Writing vice director Yin Jingren was also made General of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔曰：「周宗以寧，實由多士，漢室之隆，亦資得人。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict said: "The house of Zhou attained tranquility through its many officers; the rise of the Han house likewise relied on obtaining capable men.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict declared: "The Zhou house found peace through its many officers, and the Han rose in glory by winning able men.

sentences.zh: 朕寐寤樂賢，為日已久，而則哲難階，明揚莫効。

translations.literal: Waking and sleeping I delight in worthies—it has been so for many days—yet sage discernment is hard to attain, and bright promotion has had no effect.
translations.idiomatic: I have long dreamed and waked with joy in worthy men, yet true discernment remains beyond reach and my calls to elevate talent have borne no fruit.

sentences.zh: 用令遺才在野，管庫虛朝，永懷前載，慚德深矣。

translations.literal: Thus outstanding talent remains in the wilds and the storehouses stand empty at court; ever recalling the records of old, my shame in virtue runs deep.
translations.idiomatic: Talented men still wander outside office while the court’s storehouses stand empty; pondering the examples of antiquity, I am deeply ashamed of my own virtue.

sentences.zh: 夫舉爾所知，宣尼之篤訓，貢士任官，先代之成准。
