translations.literal: To raise those whom you know is the Kongzi’s earnest teaching; to present scholars and assign them office is the established standard of former ages.
translations.idiomatic: "Recommend those you know" is Confucius’s earnest teaching; presenting scholars and appointing them to office is the settled standard of former ages.

sentences.zh: 便可宣敕內外，各有薦舉。

translations.literal: Let an edict now be proclaimed within and without, that each may make recommendations.
translations.idiomatic: Let an edict go forth within and without the court, and let every office submit recommendations.

sentences.zh: 當依方銓引，以觀厥用。

translations.literal: They shall be weighed and promoted by measure, to observe what use they can serve."
translations.idiomatic: They shall be assessed and advanced according to their measure, that we may see what service they can render."

sentences.zh: 」是夜，京都地震。

translations.literal: ” That night the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That night the capital was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 六月，丹陽、淮南、吳興、義興大水，京邑乘船。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Danyang, Huainan, Wuxing, and Yixing suffered great flooding; in the capital people traveled by boat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Danyang, Huainan, Wuxing, and Yixing were inundated, and in the capital people went about by boat.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以徐豫南兗三州、會稽宣城二郡米數百萬斛賜五郡遭水民。

translations.literal: On jiyou, several million hu of grain from Xu, Yu, and Southern Yan provinces and from Kuaiji and Xuancheng commanderies were granted to the people of the five flood-stricken commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou several million hu of grain from Xu, Yu, and Southern Yan and from Kuaiji and Xuancheng were distributed to the people of the five flood-stricken commanderies.

sentences.zh: 是月，斷酒。

translations.literal: That month the sale of wine was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court banned the sale of wine.

sentences.zh: 師子國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The Lion Country sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: The Lion Country (Sri Lanka) sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，[15]闍婆娑達國、扶南國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinyou, [15] the states of Campasataka and Funan both sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the seventh autumn month, [15] Campasataka and Funan each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，於益州立南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on renshen, the three commanderies of Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi were established in Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen of the eighth month Yi Province gained the three new commanderies of Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi.

sentences.zh: [16]乙亥，原遭水郡諸逋負。

translations.literal: [16] On yihai, all overdue obligations in the flood-stricken commanderies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: [16] On yihai all outstanding levies in the flood-stricken commanderies were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 九月，蜀郡賊張尋為寇。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the bandit Zhang Xun of Shu Commandery rose in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the outlaw Zhang Xun of Shu Commandery took up arms.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，以右軍行參軍苟道覆為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Gou Daofu, Acting Staff Officer of the Right Army, was made Jiao Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh winter month Right Army acting staff officer Gou Daofu was appointed inspector of Jiao.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月癸丑，上有疾，不朝會。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the thirteenth year, on guichou, the Emperor was ill and did not hold court audience.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the thirteenth year’s first spring month the emperor fell ill and ceased holding court.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，司空、江州刺史檀道濟有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiwei, Tan Daoji, Minister of Works and Jiang Province Inspector, was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the third month Tan Daoji, Minister of Works and inspector of Jiang, was found guilty and put to death.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On gengshen, a general amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 以中軍將軍南譙王義宣為鎮南將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao and General of the Central Army, was made Pacifying-South General and Jiang Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, central army general, was made Pacifying-South general and inspector of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊辰，鎮北將軍、徐兗二州刺史王仲德進號鎮北大將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on wuchen, Wang Zhongde, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was advanced in title to Pacifying-North Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the fifth summer month pacifying-north general Wang Zhongde, inspector of Xu and Yan, was promoted to Pacifying-North Grand General.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以征北司馬王方俳為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Wang Fangpai, Staff Officer of the Campaigning-North General, was made Yan Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen campaigning-north staff officer Wang Fangpai was appointed inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 六月，高麗國、武都王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Goguryeo and the King of Wudu sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Goguryeo and the King of Wudu sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，尚書僕射、中護軍殷景仁改為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengyin, Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General of the Central Army, was changed to Protector of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the eighth month Yin Jingren relinquished his posts as vice director and central army general and became Protector of the Army.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，立第二皇子濬為始興王，第三皇子駿為武陵王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guichou, the second imperial son Jun was established as Prince of Shixing, and the third imperial son Jun as Prince of Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou of the ninth month the second prince, Jun, was enfeoffed as Prince of Shixing and the third prince, Jun, as Prince of Wuling.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月辛卯，車駕親祠南郊，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourteenth year, on xinmao, the imperial carriage personally performed sacrifice at the southern suburb, and a general amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the fourteenth year’s first spring month the emperor sacrificed at the southern suburb and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 文武賜位一等；

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted one rank in status;
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were each advanced one rank in status;

sentences.zh: 孤老、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: orphans and the aged living alone, and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves, were each granted five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: and each orphan or elderly person living alone, and anyone disabled by the six infirmities who could not support himself, received five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，以步兵校尉劉真道為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renzi, Liu Zhendao, Colonel of Footsoldiers, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi of the second month footsoldier colonel Liu Zhendao was appointed inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，以輔國將軍周籍之為益州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on dingwei, Zhou Jizhi, General Who Assists the State, was made Yi Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the fourth summer month state-assisting general Zhou Jizhi was made inspector of Yi.

sentences.zh: 秋八月戊午，以尚書金部郎中徐森之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on wuwu, Xu Senzhi, Gentleman of the Gold Section in the Masters of Writing, was made Jiao Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the eighth autumn month Xu Senzhi of the Masters of Writing gold section was appointed inspector of Jiao.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月辛酉，停賀雪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on xinyou, the rite of congratulating on snow was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of the twelfth winter month the court suspended the snow-congratulation ceremony.

sentences.zh: 河南國、河西王、訶羅單國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The states of Henan, the King of Hexi, and Heluodan all sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Henan, the King of Hexi, and Heluodan each sent envoys with tribute.

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.

sentences.zh: 十五年春二月丁未，以平東將軍吐谷渾慕容延為鎮西將軍、秦河二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the fifteenth year, on dingwei, Murong Yan of Tuyuhun, General Who Pacifies the East, was made Pacifying-West General and Inspector of Qin and He provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the fifteenth year’s second spring month Murong Yan of Tuyuhun, eastern pacifying general, was made western pacifying general and inspector of Qin and He.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，燕王弘遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiachen, Prince of Yan Hong sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the fourth summer month Prince of Yan Hong sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: [19]立皇太子妃殷氏，賜王公以下各有差。

translations.literal: [19] The consort of the Crown Prince of the Yin clan was established, and kings, dukes, and those below were each granted gifts according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: [19] The crown prince’s consort of the Yin clan was installed, and kings, dukes, and officials below them received graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以倭國王珍為安東將軍。

translations.literal: On jisi, King Zhen of Wa was made Pacifying-East General.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the king of Wa (Japan), Zhen, was appointed Pacifying-East general.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，特進、右光祿大夫殷穆卒。

translations.literal: On jichou, Yin Mu, Special Grand Master and Right Grand Master of the Palace, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou special grand master Yin Mu, Right Grand Master of the Palace, passed away.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鎮北大將軍、徐州刺史王仲德卒。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Wang Zhongde, Pacifying-North Grand General and Xu Province Inspector, died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao pacifying-north grand general Wang Zhongde, inspector of Xu, died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以右衞將軍劉遵考為徐、兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: On renchen, Liu Zunkao, General of the Right Guard, was made Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen right guard general Liu Zunkao was appointed inspector of Xu and Yan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，地震。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the seventh autumn month an earthquake struck.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以陳、南頓二郡太守徐循為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Xu Xun, Administrator of Chen and Nandun commanderies, was made Ning Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Chen and Nandun administrator Xu Xun was made inspector of Ning.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，以左衞將軍趙伯符為徐、兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinchou, Zhao Bofu, General of the Left Guard, was made Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou of the eighth month left guard general Zhao Bofu was appointed inspector of Xu and Yan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以始興內史陸徽為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Lu Hui, Administrator of Shixing, was made Guang Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Shixing administrator Lu Hui became inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以兗州刺史王方俳為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Wang Fangpai, Yan Province Inspector, was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Yan inspector Wang Fangpai was given Qing and Ji as well.

sentences.zh: 是歲，武都王、河南國、高麗國、倭國、扶南國、林邑國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year the King of Wudu, the state of Henan, Goguryeo, Wa, Funan, and Linyi all sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: That year the King of Wudu, Henan, Goguryeo, Wa (Japan), Funan, and Linyi all sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月戊寅，車駕於北郊閱武。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixteenth year, on wuyin, the imperial carriage reviewed troops at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the sixteenth year’s first spring month the emperor reviewed troops at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史彭城王義康進位大將軍，領司徒，餘如故。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of the Masters of Writing, and Yang Province Inspector, was advanced in rank to Grand General; he continued as Minister over the Masses, and the rest of his offices remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Minister over the Masses, recorder of the Masters of Writing, and Yang inspector, was promoted to Grand General while retaining the ministry and his other posts.

sentences.zh: 征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭進位司空，刺史如故。

translations.literal: Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, Campaigning-North General, Commissioner with Credentials Equal to the Three Dukes, and Southern Yan Province Inspector, was advanced in rank to Minister of Works; his inspectorship remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, campaigning-north general with credentials equal to the Three Dukes and inspector of Southern Yan, was promoted to Minister of Works and kept his inspectorship.

sentences.zh: 特進、左光祿大夫王敬弘開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Wang Jinghong, Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace, was given the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jinghong, Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace, received an opening office equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，復分荊州置湘州。

translations.literal: On guisi, Jing Province was again divided to establish Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Jing was again partitioned to create Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，以南徐州刺史衡陽王義季為安西將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jihai, Yiji, Prince of Hengyang and Southern Xu Province Inspector, was made Pacifying-West General and Jing Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the second month Prince of Hengyang Yiji, inspector of Southern Xu, was made western pacifying general and inspector of Jing.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以始興王濬為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Prince of Shixing Jun was made Xiang Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Prince of Shixing Jun was appointed inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，割梁州之巴西梓潼南宕渠南漢中、南秦州之南安懷寧凡六郡，[20]屬益州。

translations.literal: On guihai, the six commanderies of Baxi, Zitong, Southern Dangqu, and Southern Hanzhong from Liang Province and Nan’an and Huaining from Southern Qin Province were severed [20] and placed under Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai six commanderies—Baxi, Zitong, Southern Dangqu, and Southern Hanzhong from Liang and Nan’an and Huaining from Southern Qin [20]—were detached and assigned to Yi.

sentences.zh: 分長沙江夏郡立巴陵郡，屬湘州。

translations.literal: Baling Commandery was established from Changsha and Jiangxia commanderies and placed under Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Baling Commandery was carved out of Changsha and Jiangxia and placed under Xiang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，以鎮南將軍、江州刺史南譙王義宣為征北將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on dingsi, Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao, Pacifying-South General and Jiang Province Inspector, was made Campaigning-North General and Southern Xu Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the fourth summer month Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, pacifying-south general and Jiang inspector, became campaigning-north general and inspector of Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 平西將軍臨川王義慶為衞將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: Yiqing, Prince of Linchuan and Pacifying-West General, was made General of the Guard and Jiang Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, western pacifying general, was made Guard general and inspector of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，隴西吐谷渾慕容延改封河南王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiyou, Murong Yan of Longxi Tuyuhun was changed in enfeoffment to King of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the sixth month Murong Yan of Longxi Tuyuhun was redesignated King of Henan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以吐谷渾拾寅為平西將軍，吐谷渾繁暱為撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: On guichou, Murong Shibin of Tuyuhun was made Pacifying-West General, and Murong Fanni of Tuyuhun was made Pacifying-Army General.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Murong Shibin of Tuyuhun was made western pacifying general and Murong Fanni pacifying-army general.

sentences.zh: 秋八月庚子，立第四皇子鑠為南平王。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on gengzi, the fourth imperial son Shuo was established as Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the eighth autumn month the fourth prince, Shuo, was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙未，鎮軍將軍、豫州刺史長沙王義欣薨。

translations.literal: On yiwei of the intercalary month, Yixin, Prince of Changsha, General of the Army and Yu Province Inspector, died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the intercalary month Prince of Changsha Yixin, army general and Yu inspector, died.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，復分豫州之淮南為南豫州。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Huainan was again divided from Yu Province to establish Southern Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Huainan was again split from Yu to form Southern Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以左衞將軍劉遵考為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On guimao, Liu Zunkao, General of the Left Guard, was made Yu Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao left guard general Liu Zunkao was appointed inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以湘州刺史始興王濬為南豫州刺史，武陵王駿為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On wushen, Prince of Shixing Jun, Xiang Province Inspector, was made Southern Yu Province Inspector, and Prince of Wuling Jun was made Xiang Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Prince of Shixing Jun exchanged Xiang for Southern Yu, and Prince of Wuling Jun took Xiang in his place.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月乙亥，皇太子冠，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on yihai, the Crown Prince underwent the capping ceremony, and a general amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the twelfth winter month the crown prince came of age in the capping rite and the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 是歲，武都王、河南王、林邑國、高麗國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year the King of Wudu, the King of Henan, Linyi, and Goguryeo sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: That year the kings of Wudu and Henan, together with Linyi and Goguryeo, sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 十七年夏四月戊午朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the seventeenth year, on wuwu, the new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year’s fourth summer month, on the new moon of wuwu, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，領軍將軍劉湛母憂去職。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guisi, Liu Zhan, General of the Army of the Palace Guard, left office on account of his mother’s mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi of the fifth month palace guard army general Liu Zhan resigned to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，以征虜諮議參軍杜驥為青州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renyin, Consulting Military Adviser under the General Who Campaigns against Invaders Du Ji was made Qingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renyin, Du Ji, consulting adviser to the General Who Campaigns against Invaders, was appointed Qingzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 壬子，皇后袁氏崩。

translations.literal: On renzi, Empress Yuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Empress Yuan (the Yuan empress) died.

sentences.zh: 八月，徐、兗、青、冀四州大水，己未，遣使檢行賑卹。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces suffered great floods; on jiwei, envoys were sent to inspect and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month great floods struck Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji; on jiwei envoys were dispatched to inspect the damage and distribute relief.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，葬元皇后於長寧陵。

translations.literal: On renzi of the ninth month, the late Empress Yuan was buried at Changning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi of the ninth month the Yuan empress was interred at Changning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，前丹陽尹劉湛有罪，及同黨伏誅。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu, former Danyang Prefect Liu Zhan was guilty of crimes, and he and his accomplices were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu, former Danyang prefect Liu Zhan was found guilty; he and his faction were put to death.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，文武賜爵一級。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire; civil and military officials were granted one rank in nobility.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was declared, and civil and military officials advanced one noble rank.

sentences.zh: 以大將軍、領司徒、錄尚書、揚州刺史彭城王義康為江州刺史，大將軍如故。

translations.literal: Grand General, Concurrent Grand Secretary, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, and Yangzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was made Jiangzhou Inspector, retaining the title of Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Pengcheng Yikang—grand general, concurrent grand secretary, supervisor of the Masters of Writing, and Yangzhou inspector—was made Jiangzhou inspector while keeping his grand general title.

sentences.zh: 以司空、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為司徒、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: Minister of Works and Southern Yanzhou Inspector Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was made Grand Secretary and Supervisor of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, minister of works and Southern Yanzhou inspector, became grand secretary and supervisor of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，衞將軍臨川王義慶以本號為南兗州刺史，尚書僕射、護軍將軍殷景仁為揚州刺史，僕射如故。

translations.literal: On wuyin, General of the Guard Prince of Linchuan Yiqing retained his present title as Southern Yanzhou Inspector; Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army Yin Jingren was made Yangzhou Inspector, retaining the post of Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, General of the Guard Prince of Linchuan Yiqing remained Southern Yanzhou inspector under his existing title; Vice Director Yin Jingren, also general who protects the army, became Yangzhou inspector while keeping the vice directorship.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，以尚書劉義融為領軍將軍，祕書監徐湛之為中護軍。

translations.literal: On bingxu of the eleventh month, Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Yirong was made General of the Central Army; Supervisor of the Palace Library Xu Tanzhi was made General of the Central Household Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the eleventh month, Director Liu Yirong was appointed general of the central army and Palace Library supervisor Xu Tanzhi general of the central household guards.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔曰：「前所給揚、南徐二州百姓田糧種子，兗、兩豫、青、徐諸州比年所寬租穀應督入者，悉除半。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict said: "The grain and seed for fields previously granted to the people of Yang and Southern Xu provinces, and the rent grain from Yan, both Yu, Qing, and Xu provinces that in recent years was reduced and should be collected and forwarded—all are remitted by half."
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai an edict declared: "Field grain and seed earlier granted to Yang and Southern Xu, and half the rent grain from Yan, both Yu, Qing, and Xu that recent tax relief still required to be forwarded, are all remitted."

sentences.zh: 今年有不收處，[21]都原之。

translations.literal: Where there is no harvest this year, [21] all are fully remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Where the harvest fails this year, [21] all obligations are cancelled outright.

sentences.zh: 凡諸逋債，優量申減。

translations.literal: All overdue debts are to be favorably assessed and reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Every outstanding debt is to be leniently reviewed and reduced.

sentences.zh: 又州郡估稅，所在市調，多有煩刻。

translations.literal: Moreover, the appraisal taxes of the provinces and commanderies and the market levies in each place are often vexatious and harsh.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial and commandery appraisal taxes and local market dues are also often burdensome and severe.

sentences.zh: 山澤之利，猶或禁斷；

translations.literal: The profits of mountains and marshes are in some places still prohibited;
translations.idiomatic: Revenue from mountains and marshes is still barred in some districts;

sentences.zh: 役召之品，遂及稚弱。

translations.literal: the categories subject to corvée conscription even reach infants and children.
translations.idiomatic: and corvée categories even extend to the very young.

sentences.zh: 諸如此比，傷治害民。

translations.literal: All such practices harm governance and injure the people.
translations.idiomatic: Such abuses damage good rule and hurt the common people.

sentences.zh: 自今咸依法令，務盡優允。

translations.literal: From now on let all act according to the laws and statutes, striving to the utmost for leniency and relief.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth all are to follow statute and law, doing their utmost to grant leniency and ease.

sentences.zh: 如有不便，即依事別言，不得苟趣一時，以乖隱卹之旨。

translations.literal: If anything is unsuitable, speak of it separately according to the matter; do not hastily pursue momentary convenience and thereby violate the purpose of hidden cherishing and relief.
translations.idiomatic: Where something will not work, report it on its merits; do not chase short-term expedients and betray the intent of compassionate governance.

sentences.zh: 主者明加宣下，稱朕意焉。

translations.literal: Let those in charge clearly proclaim this downward and declare my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Let responsible officials proclaim this clearly throughout the realm and make my will known.

sentences.zh: 」癸丑，尚書僕射、揚州刺史殷景仁卒。

translations.literal: "] On guichou, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Yangzhou Inspector Yin Jingren died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Vice Director and Yangzhou inspector Yin Jingren died.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On guihai of the twelfth month, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Wang Qiu was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai of the twelfth month, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Wang Qiu was appointed vice director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: [22]戊辰，以南豫州刺史始興王濬為揚州刺史，湘州刺史武陵王駿為南豫州刺史，南平王鑠為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: [22] On wuchen, Southern Yuzhou Inspector Prince of Shixing Jun was made Yangzhou Inspector; Xiangzhou Inspector Prince of Wuling Jun was made Southern Yuzhou Inspector; Prince of Nanping Shuo was made Xiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: [22] On wuchen, Prince of Shixing Jun moved from Southern Yuzhou to Yangzhou; Prince of Wuling Jun took Southern Yuzhou from Xiangzhou; and Prince of Nanping Shuo became Xiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 是歲，武都王、河南王、百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year, the King of Wudu, the King of Henan, and the state of Baekje sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: That year the kings of Wudu and Henan and the state of Baekje sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十八年春二月乙卯，以豫章太守庾登之為江州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring in year 18, on yimao, Yuzhang Prefect Yu Dengzhi was made Jiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring, year 18, on yimao, Yuzhang prefect Yu Dengzhi was appointed Jiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬午，[23]衞將軍南兗州刺史臨川王義慶、征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣並開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on renwu, [23] General of the Guard and Southern Yanzhou Inspector Prince of Linchuan Yiqing and General Who Campaigns North and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan were both granted Opening Office with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on renwu, [23] Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, general of the guard and Southern Yanzhou inspector, and Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, general who campaigns north and Southern Xuzhou inspector, both received opening office equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，於交州置宋熙郡。

translations.literal: On guisi, the commandery of Songxi was established in Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the commandery of Songxi was set up in Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 是月，沔水泛溢。

translations.literal: That month, the Han River overflowed its banks.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Han River flooded.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，遣使巡行賑贍。

translations.literal: On wuchen of the sixth month, envoys were sent to tour the regions and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen of the sixth month envoys were dispatched to tour the districts and distribute relief.

sentences.zh: 辛未，領軍將軍劉義融卒。

translations.literal: On xinwei, General of the Central Army Liu Yirong died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, general of the central army Liu Yirong died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，以徐、兗二州刺史趙伯符為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On wuxu of the seventh month of autumn, Xuzhou and Yanzhou Inspector Zhao Bofu was made General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the seventh month of autumn, Xuzhou and Yanzhou inspector Zhao Bofu was appointed general of the central army.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，以巴東、建平二郡太守臧質為徐、兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinhai of the tenth month of winter, Prefect of Badong and Jianping commanderies Zang Zhi was made Xuzhou and Yanzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the tenth month of winter, Zang Zhi, prefect of Badong and Jianping, became Xuzhou and Yanzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，省南徐州之南燕、濮陽、南廣平郡。

translations.literal: On yimao, the commanderies of Nanyan, Puyang, and Nanguangping in Southern Xuzhou were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Southern Xuzhou commanderies Nanyan, Puyang, and Nanguangping were abolished.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，尚書僕射王球卒。

translations.literal: On wuzi of the eleventh month, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Qiu died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the eleventh month, Vice Director Wang Qiu died.

sentences.zh: [24]己亥，以丹陽尹孟顗為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: [24] On jihai, Danyang Prefect Meng Yi was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: [24] On jihai, Danyang prefect Meng Yi was appointed vice director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 氐楊難當又寇漢川。

translations.literal: Yang Nachang of the Di again raided Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Nachang of the Di again invaded Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，遣龍驤將軍裴方明與梁、秦二州刺史劉真道討之。

translations.literal: On guihai of the twelfth month, Dragon Cavalry General Pei Fangming and Liang and Qin provinces Inspector Liu Zhendao were dispatched to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai of the twelfth month, Dragon Cavalry General Pei Fangming and Liang-Qin inspector Liu Zhendao were sent to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 是月，[25]晉寧太守爨松子反叛，寧州刺史徐循討平之。

translations.literal: That month, [25] Jinning Prefect Cuan Songzi rebelled; Ningzhou Inspector Xu Xun suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: That month, [25] Jinning prefect Cuan Songzi rose in rebellion; Ningzhou inspector Xu Xun put down the revolt.

sentences.zh: 是歲，肅特國、高麗國、蘇靡黎國、林邑國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year, Sute, Goguryeo, Sumali, and Linyi all sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys from Sute, Goguryeo, Sumali, and Linyi arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十九年正月乙巳，詔曰：「夫所因者本，聖哲之遠教；

translations.literal: On yisi of the first month in year 19, an edict said: "What one builds upon is the root—the distant teaching of sages and worthies;
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of the first month, year 19, an edict declared: "What is founded upon is the root—the far-off instruction of sages and worthies;

sentences.zh: 本立化成，斆學之為貴。

translations.literal: when the root is established, transformation through culture takes form, and reverent learning is held in esteem.
translations.idiomatic: once the root stands firm, culture takes shape through teaching, and devoted study is prized above all.

sentences.zh: 故詔以三德，崇以四術，用能納諸義方，致之軌度。

translations.literal: Therefore they were charged with the three virtues and honored with the four arts, so as to take in all proper directions and bring them to measure and rule.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the three virtues were enjoined and the four arts exalted, enabling every proper path to be gathered in and brought to standard.

sentences.zh: 盛王聖世，[26]咸必由之。

translations.literal: In flourishing kingship and sage ages, [26] all necessarily followed this path.
translations.idiomatic: In ages of great kings and holy rulers, [26] none failed to walk this way.

sentences.zh: 永初受命，憲章弘遠，將陶鈞庶品，混一殊風，有詔典司，大啟庠序，而頻遘屯夷，未及修建。

translations.literal: When Yongchu first received the mandate, statutes and regulations were broad and far-reaching, intending to mold the myriad categories in the crucible and blend diverse customs into one; there were edicts to the directing offices to greatly open schools, but we repeatedly encountered hardships and disturbances and did not reach completion in building them.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of Yongchu the laws were proclaimed on a grand scale, aiming to shape all ranks in the crucible and unify disparate customs; edicts ordered the responsible offices to open schools widely, yet repeated calamities left construction unfinished.

sentences.zh: 永瞻前猷，思敷鴻烈。

translations.literal: Ever gazing upon the former design, we think to spread the great achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Ever looking back to the plans of old, we long to extend that magnificent enterprise.

sentences.zh: 今方隅乂寧，戎夏慕嚮，廣訓冑子，實維時務。

translations.literal: Now the four corners are at peace, barbarians and Chinese alike look in admiration, and broadly instructing the heirs—sons of the nobility—is truly the task of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Now the realm is tranquil, north and south look to the court, and to train the crown princes broadly is truly the urgent business of the time.

sentences.zh: 便可式遵成規，闡揚景業。」

translations.literal: Let us at once model the established regulations and extend and display the resplendent enterprise."
translations.idiomatic: Let the court at once follow the settled precedent and raise high this splendid undertaking."

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，以久疾愈，始奉礿祠，[27]大赦天下。

translations.literal: On jiaxu of the fourth month of summer, having recovered from long illness, he for the first time performed the yue sacrifice; [27] a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu of the fourth month of summer, recovered from a long illness, he offered the yue ancestral rites for the first time; [27] a general amnesty followed.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，梁秦二州刺史劉真道、龍驤將軍裴方明破氐楊難當，仇池平。

translations.literal: On gengyin of the fifth month, Liang and Qin provinces Inspector Liu Zhendao and Dragon Cavalry General Pei Fangming defeated Yang Nachang of the Di, and Chou Pool was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the fifth month, Liu Zhendao and Pei Fangming crushed the Di leader Yang Nachang and pacified Chou Pool.

sentences.zh: 閏月，京邑雨水；

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, the capital region suffered rain flooding;
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month the capital was inundated by rain;

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣使巡行賑卹。

translations.literal: on dingsi, envoys were sent to tour and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: on dingsi envoys were sent to inspect the damage and distribute relief.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，以大沮渠無諱為征西大將軍、涼州刺史。

translations.literal: On renwu of the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui of Northern Liang was made General Who Campaigns in the West and Liangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui of Northern Liang was appointed general who campaigns in the west and Liangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，以梁、秦二州刺史劉真道為雍州刺史，龍驤將軍裴方明為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Liang and Qin provinces Inspector Liu Zhendao was made Yongzhou Inspector; Dragon Cavalry General Pei Fangming was made Liang and Southern Qin provinces Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, Liu Zhendao moved from Liang and Qin to Yongzhou, and Pei Fangming became inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 甲戌晦，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the last day of jiaxu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of jiaxu month-day, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On jiashen of the tenth month of winter, Rouran sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the tenth month of winter, Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以晉寧太守周萬歲為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On jihai, Jinning Prefect Zhou Wansui was made Ningzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Jinning prefect Zhou Wansui was appointed Ningzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，詔曰：「冑子始集，學業方興。

translations.literal: On bingshen of the twelfth month, an edict said: "The heirs—sons are beginning to assemble and studies are just flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen of the twelfth month an edict said: "The crown princes are gathering and learning is rising anew.

sentences.zh: 自微言泯絕，逝將千祀，感事思人，意有慨然。

translations.literal: Since the subtle words were extinguished, nearly a thousand years have passed; moved by the matter we think of the man, and a sigh rises in the heart.
translations.idiomatic: Since the subtle teachings fell silent, nearly a millennium has gone by; reflecting on the affair, we think of the man and cannot but sigh.

sentences.zh: 奉聖之胤，可速議繼襲。

translations.literal: The descendants of the Sage venerated in sacrifice—let succession be swiftly deliberated and appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Let the line of the Sage honored in sacrifice be quickly chosen for succession.

sentences.zh: 於先廟地，特為營造，依舊給祠置令，四時饗祀。

translations.literal: On the site of the former temple, let it be specially built, and as of old provide for sacrifice and appoint an overseer, with offerings in the four seasons.
translations.idiomatic: On the ground of the former shrine let a temple be specially erected; as before, provide for sacrifice, appoint a custodian, and offer seasonal rites in the four seasons.

sentences.zh: 闕里往經寇亂，黌校殘毀，并下魯郡修復學舍，採召生徒。

translations.literal: Que Li has in the past suffered bandit turmoil; the school halls lie ruined—issue orders to Lu Commandery as well to repair the study halls and recruit students.
translations.idiomatic: Que Li has endured raids and disorder; its academy lies in ruins—order Lu Commandery likewise to restore the school buildings and enroll students.

sentences.zh: 昔之賢哲及一介之善，猶或衞其丘壟，禁其芻牧，況尼父德表生民，功被百代，而墳塋荒蕪，荊棘弗翦。

translations.literal: Worthies and sages of old, and even a scrap of goodness, might still have their burial mounds guarded and pasturage on them forbidden—how much more Confucius, whose virtue marks the living generation and whose merit covers a hundred ages, while his tomb and grave lie waste and overgrown and brambles go uncut.
translations.idiomatic: Men of old, however slight their merit, might still have their mounds protected and grazing forbidden—how much more Confucius, whose virtue illumines the age and whose merit spans a hundred generations, while his grave lies desolate and thorns go untrimmed.

sentences.zh: 可蠲墓側數戶，以掌洒掃。

translations.literal: Let several households beside the tomb be exempted to take charge of sprinkling and sweeping.
translations.idiomatic: Exempt several households beside the tomb to tend sprinkling and sweeping.

sentences.zh: 」魯郡上民孔景等五戶居近孔子墓側，蠲其課役，供給洒掃，并種松栢六百株。

translations.literal: "] The leading clansmen of Lu Commandery, Kong Jing and four other households totaling five, dwelling near Confucius’s tomb, had their tax and corvée remitted, were supplied for sprinkling and sweeping, and moreover planted six hundred pine and cypress trees.
translations.idiomatic: Five leading households of Lu Commandery, including Kong Jing, living beside Confucius’s tomb, were exempted from tax and corvée, supplied for upkeep, and planted six hundred pine and cypress trees.

sentences.zh: 是歲，婆皇國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year, the state of Pohuang sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys from Pohuang arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月，於臺城東西開萬春、千秋二門。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in year 20, the Wan Spring and Thousand Autumns gates were opened east and west of the Terrace City.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, year 20, the Wan Spring and Thousand Autumns gates were opened on the east and west of the Terrace City.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，江州刺史庾登之為中護軍。

translations.literal: On jiaxu of the second month, Jiangzhou Inspector Yu Dengzhi was made General of the Central Household Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu of the second month, Jiangzhou inspector Yu Dengzhi became general of the central household guards.

sentences.zh: 庚申，[28]以廬陵王紹為江州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengshen, [28] Prince of Luling Shao was made Jiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, [28] Prince of Luling Shao was appointed Jiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 仇池為索虜所沒。

translations.literal: Chou Pool was lost to the Northern barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Chou Pool fell to the Northern Wei.

sentences.zh: 甲申，車駕於白下閱武。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the imperial carriage reviewed troops at Baixia.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the emperor reviewed the army at Baixia.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，安西將軍、荊州刺史衡陽王義季進號征西大將軍。

translations.literal: On xinhai of the third month, General Who Pacifies the West and Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Hengyang Yiji was promoted to General Who Campaigns in the West.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the third month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, general who pacifies the west and Jingzhou inspector, was promoted to general who campaigns in the west.

sentences.zh: 以巴西、梓潼二郡太守申坦為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: Prefect of Baxi and Zitong commanderies Shen Tan was made Liang and Southern Qin provinces Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Tan, prefect of Baxi and Zitong, was appointed inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，立第六皇子誕為廣陵王。

translations.literal: On jiawu of the fourth month of summer, the sixth prince, Dan, was established as Prince of Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu of the fourth month of summer, the sixth prince Dan was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangling.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，中護軍庾登之卒。

translations.literal: On guichou of the fifth month, General of the Central Household Guards Yu Dengzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou of the fifth month, general of the central household guards Yu Dengzhi died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，以楊文德為征西將軍、北秦州刺史，封武都王。

translations.literal: On guichou of the seventh month of autumn, Yang Wende was made General Who Campaigns in the West and Northern Qinzhou Inspector and enfeoffed as King of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou of the seventh month of autumn, Yang Wende was made general who campaigns in the west and Northern Qinzhou inspector and enfeoffed as king of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以南蠻校尉蕭思話為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Colonel of the Southern Man Xiao Sihua was made Yongzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Colonel of the Southern Man Xiao Sihua was appointed Yongzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 甲子，前雍州刺史劉真道、梁南秦二州刺史裴方明有罪，下獄死。

translations.literal: On jiazi, former Yongzhou Inspector Liu Zhendao and Liang and Southern Qin provinces Inspector Pei Fangming were guilty of crimes, cast into prison, and died there.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, former Yongzhou inspector Liu Zhendao and Liang-Southern Qin inspector Pei Fangming were found guilty, imprisoned, and died in custody.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，以廷尉陶愍祖為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On guiwei of the eighth month, Commandant of Punishments Tao Minzu was made Guangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei of the eighth month, Commandant of Punishments Tao Minzu was appointed Guangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月庚午，以始興內史檀和之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengwu of the twelfth month of winter, Shixing Interior Secretary Tan Hezhi was made Jiaozhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu of the twelfth month of winter, Shixing interior secretary Tan Hezhi was appointed Jiaozhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔曰：「國以民為本，民以食為天。

translations.literal: On renwu, an edict said: "The state takes the people as its root; the people take food as their Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu an edict declared: "The state rests on the people; the people rest on grain.

sentences.zh: 故一夫輟稼，饑者必及。

translations.literal: Thus if one man stops plowing, hunger is sure to reach others.
translations.idiomatic: When a single farmer leaves the fields, hunger reaches his neighbors.

sentences.zh: 倉廩既實，禮節以興。

translations.literal: When the granaries are full, ritual and propriety arise.
translations.idiomatic: Full granaries give rise to ritual and decorum.

sentences.zh: 自頃在所貧罄，家無宿積。

translations.literal: Of late in every place poverty is exhausted and households have no stored surplus.
translations.idiomatic: Lately every district is destitute and homes hold no reserve grain.

sentences.zh: 賦役暫偏，則人懷愁墊；

translations.literal: When taxes and corvée are for a time uneven, people harbor grief and distress;
translations.idiomatic: When levies fall unevenly, the people sink into misery;

sentences.zh: 歲或不稔，而病乏比室。

translations.literal: when the year is sometimes not ripe, sickness and want visit neighboring houses.
translations.idiomatic: when harvests fail, sickness and want spread from door to door.

sentences.zh: 誠由政德弗孚，以臻斯弊；

translations.literal: It is truly because governmental virtue does not win trust that we reach these abuses;
translations.idiomatic: This indeed comes of a government whose virtue has not won the people’s trust;

sentences.zh: 抑亦耕桑未廣，地利多遺。

translations.literal: yet also because plowing and sericulture are not widespread and the land’s benefit is much left unused.
translations.idiomatic: yet also because farming and sericulture are not broad enough and much of the land’s yield goes untapped.

sentences.zh: 宰守微化導之方，萌庶忘勤分之義。

translations.literal: Prefects and magistrates slight the means of instructing and guiding through moral transformation, and the common people forget the meaning of diligent apportionment of labor.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates neglect to teach and guide, and the people forget their share of honest toil.

sentences.zh: 永言弘濟，明發載懷。

translations.literal: Ever speaking of broadly aiding the people, at dawn we bear it in mind.
translations.idiomatic: We speak constantly of relieving the people, and at daybreak the thought is still upon us.

sentences.zh: 雖制令亟下，終莫懲勸，而坐望滋殖，庸可致乎。

translations.literal: Though regulations and orders issue repeatedly, in the end none are warned and encouraged—yet we sit and look for increase and growth; how can it be attained?
translations.idiomatic: Edicts rain down yet no one is moved to reform—still we expect abundance to appear of itself; how can that happen?

sentences.zh: 有司其班宣舊條，務盡敦課。

translations.literal: Let the responsible offices proclaim the old provisions and strive to the utmost in earnest instruction and assessment.
translations.idiomatic: Let the responsible offices publish the old statutes and press hard on earnest supervision and instruction.

sentences.zh: 遊食之徒，咸令附業，考覈勤惰，行其誅賞，觀察能殿，嚴加黜陟。

translations.literal: All who wander and eat without fixed occupation are to be ordered to attach to occupations; examine and assess diligence and sloth, apply rewards and punishments, observe capacity in administration, and strictly carry out demotion and promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Vagrants are to be made to settle into work; diligence and idleness are to be checked, rewards and punishments enforced, competence in office observed, and promotion and dismissal applied rigorously.

sentences.zh: 古者躬耕帝籍，敬供粢盛，仰瞻前王，思遵令典。

translations.literal: In antiquity the emperor personally plowed the imperial fields and respectfully supplied the sacrificial grain; looking up to former kings, we think to follow the established canon.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient kings plowed the sacred fields themselves and furnished the sacrificial grain; looking to their example, we mean to follow that ordinance.

sentences.zh: 便可量處千畝，考卜元辰。

translations.literal: Let a measure of a thousand mu be set aside and the auspicious day divined.
translations.idiomatic: Let a thousand mu be marked out and the propitious day chosen by divination.

sentences.zh: 朕當親率百辟，致禮郊甸，庶幾誠素，將被斯民。」

translations.literal: I shall personally lead the hundred officials and perform rites in the suburban fields, hoping that sincerity and simplicity will be spread upon this people."
translations.idiomatic: I shall lead the hundred officials in person to perform the suburban rites, so that honest simplicity may reach the people."

sentences.zh: 是歲，河西國、高麗國、百濟國、倭國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year, Hexi, Goguryeo, Baekje, and Wa all sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys from Hexi, Goguryeo, Baekje, and Wa arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是歲，諸州郡水旱傷稼，民大饑。

translations.literal: That year, many provinces and commanderies suffered flood and drought damaging the crops; the people suffered great famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods and droughts ruined the harvest across many provinces and commanderies, and famine gripped the people.

sentences.zh: 遣使開倉賑卹，給賜糧種。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to open the granaries for relief and bestow grain and seed.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to open the storehouses, grant relief, and distribute grain and seed.

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月己亥，南徐、南豫州、揚州之浙江西，[29]並禁酒。

translations.literal: On jihai of the first month of spring in year 21, in Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and the region west of the Zhe River in Yang Province, [29] wine was prohibited throughout.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the first month of spring, year 21, Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and the lands west of the Zhe River in Yang Province [29] were placed under a general ban on wine.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was declared for the empire.

sentences.zh: 諸逋債在十九年以前，一切原除。

translations.literal: All overdue debts from before year 19 are fully remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Every outstanding debt dating to before the nineteenth year is cancelled outright.

sentences.zh: 去歲失收者，疇量申減。

translations.literal: Where there was no harvest last year, assess by field and report reductions.
translations.idiomatic: Where last year’s harvest failed, reductions are to be surveyed field by field and reported.

sentences.zh: 尤弊之處，遣使就郡縣隨宜賑卹。

translations.literal: In places of extreme hardship, envoys are sent to the commanderies and counties to grant relief as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: In the worst-afflicted districts, envoys are dispatched to the commanderies and counties to distribute relief as local conditions require.

sentences.zh: 凡欲附農，而種糧匱乏者，並加給貸。

translations.literal: All who wish to attach to farming but lack seed grain are to be given additional loans.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone wishing to settle on the land but short of seed is to receive extra grain on loan.

sentences.zh: 營千畝諸統司役人，賜布各有差。

translations.literal: Corvée laborers of the thousand-mu estate units are each granted cloth in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée workers on the thousand-mu estates receive cloth stipends graded by rank.

sentences.zh: 戊午，衞將軍臨川王義慶薨。

translations.literal: On wuwu, General of the Guard Prince of Linchuan Yiqing died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, general of the guard, died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以太子詹事劉義宗為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Crown Prince Household Steward Liu Yizong was made Southern Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, crown prince household steward Liu Yizong was appointed Southern Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，以領軍將軍趙伯符為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengwu, General of the Household Guards Zhao Bofu was made Yuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengwu, household guards general Zhao Bofu became Yuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 己丑，司徒、錄尚書事江夏王義恭進位太尉，領司徒。

translations.literal: On jichou, Minister over the Masses and Supervisor of the Masters of Writing Prince of Jiangxia Yigong advanced to Grand Commandant, retaining Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong—minister over the masses and supervisor of the Masters of Writing—was promoted to grand commandant while keeping the ministry of works.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以右衞將軍沈演之為中領軍。

translations.literal: On gengyin, General of the Right Guard Shen Yanzhi was made General of the Central Household Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, right guard general Shen Yanzhi was appointed general of the central household guards.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，立第七皇子宏為建平王。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the seventh imperial son Hong was established as Prince of Jianping.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the seventh prince Hong was enfeoffed as Prince of Jianping.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以廣陵王誕為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Prince of Guangling Dan was made Southern Yanzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Prince of Guangling Dan was appointed Southern Yanzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，晉陵延陵民徐耕以米千斛助卹饑民。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Xu Geng of Yanling in Jinling commandery presented a thousand hu of grain to relieve the famine-stricken people.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, Xu Geng of Yanling in Jinling donated a thousand hu of grain to feed the hungry.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，以尚書何尚之為中護軍，諮議參軍劉道錫為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On renxu of the fifth month, Minister of the Masters of Writing He Shangzhi was made General Who Protects the Army; Consulting Military Adviser Liu Daoxi was made Guangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu of the fifth month, He Shangzhi of the Masters of Writing became general who protects the army, and consulting adviser Liu Daoxi became Guangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 六月，連雨水。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, rain fell continuously.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth month brought unbroken rain.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔曰：「霖雨彌日，水潦為患，百姓積儉，易致乏匱。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict said: "Days of steady rain have turned into flooding; the people, long frugal, are easily driven to want."
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai an edict declared: "Prolonged rain has brought floods; after years of thrift the people are quickly reduced to need."

sentences.zh: 二縣官長及營署部司，各隨統檢實，給其柴米，必使周悉。」

translations.literal: The magistrates of the two counties and the supervising officers of the camps and offices are each, according to their jurisdiction, to inspect and verify and supply firewood and grain, making certain that nothing is left wanting."
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates of the two counties and camp and office supervisors are to check their jurisdictions, verify needs, and issue firewood and grain until every household is provided for."

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，揚州刺史始興王濬加中軍將軍，南豫州刺史武陵王駿加撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingyou, Yangzhou Inspector Prince of Shixing Jun was given the additional title General of the Central Army; Southern Yuzhou Inspector Prince of Wuling Jun was given the additional title General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the seventh autumn month, Prince of Shixing Jun, Yangzhou inspector, was made general of the central army, and Prince of Wuling Jun, Southern Yuzhou inspector, general who pacifies the army.

sentences.zh: [30]乙巳，詔曰：「比年穀稼傷損，淫亢成災，亦由播殖之宜，尚有未盡。

translations.literal: [30] On yisi, an edict said: "In recent years the grain harvest has been injured, and excessive drought has become a disaster—this is also because the fit seasons for sowing are still not fully observed."
translations.idiomatic: [30] On yisi an edict declared: "Harvests have suffered in recent years and drought has become a calamity—partly because sowing seasons are still not fully kept."

sentences.zh: 南徐、兗、豫及揚州浙江西屬郡，自今悉督種麥，以助闕乏。

translations.literal: In Southern Xu, Yan, Yu, and the commanderies west of the Zhe River belonging to Yang Province, from now on wheat is to be supervised and planted throughout, to help supply what is lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Xu, Yan, Yu, and the Yangzhou commanderies west of the Zhe are henceforth to plant wheat under supervision to fill the shortfall.

sentences.zh: 速運彭城下邳郡見種，委刺史貸給。

translations.literal: Quickly transport the seed on hand in Pengcheng and Xiapi commanderies and entrust it to the inspectors for loan and distribution.
translations.idiomatic: Seed stock in Pengcheng and Xiapi is to be rushed forward and lent out by the provincial inspectors.

sentences.zh: 徐、豫土多稻田，而民間專務陸作，可符二鎮，履行舊陂，相率修立，并課墾闢，使及來年。

translations.literal: Xu and Yu have much paddy land, yet the people devote themselves solely to dry-field crops; orders are to be sent to the two military districts to follow the old embankments, repair them together, and moreover assign reclamation—so that this may be achieved by next year.
translations.idiomatic: Xu and Yu are rich in paddies yet farmers favor dry crops; the two frontier commands are ordered to restore old dikes jointly, open new fields, and finish the work within the year.

sentences.zh: 凡諸州郡，皆令盡勤地利，勸導播殖，蠶桑麻紵，各盡其方，不得但奉行公文而已。」

translations.literal: In all provinces and commanderies, let every inch of land’s benefit be diligently pursued; encourage sowing; mulberry, hemp, and ramie each according to its proper method—do not merely carry out documents on paper."
translations.idiomatic: Every province and commandery must exploit its soil to the full, promote planting, and raise silk, hemp, and ramie each in its season—not merely shuffle paperwork."

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，征西大將軍、荊州刺史衡陽王義季為征北大將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史，征北將軍、南徐州刺史南譙王義宣為車騎將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuchen of the eighth month, General Who Campaigns in the West and Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Hengyang Yiji was made General Who Campaigns in the North, Opening Office with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, and Southern Xuzhou Inspector; General Who Campaigns in the North and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Jingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen of the eighth month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji became northern campaigning general with opening office equal to the Three Excellencies and Southern Xuzhou inspector; Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan became general of chariots and cavalry and Jingzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: [31]南兗州刺史廣陵王誕為南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: [31] Southern Yanzhou Inspector Prince of Guangling Dan was made Southern Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: [31] Prince of Guangling Dan moved from Southern Yanzhou to Southern Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，以大沮渠安周為征西將軍、涼州刺史，封河西王。

translations.literal: On jiachen of the ninth month, Juqu Anzhou of Northern Liang was made General Who Campaigns in the West and Liangzhou Inspector and enfeoffed as King of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the ninth month, Juqu Anzhou of Northern Liang was made western campaigning general and Liangzhou inspector and enfeoffed king of Hexi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，以左軍將軍徐瓊為兗州刺史，大將軍參軍申恬為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jimao, General of the Left Army Xu Qiong was made Yanzhou Inspector; Grand General Staff Officer Shen Tian was made Jizhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on jimao, left army general Xu Qiong became Yanzhou inspector and grand general staff officer Shen Tian Jizhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月辛卯朔，改用御史中丞何承天元嘉新曆。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of year 22, on xinmao, the new Yuanjia calendar of Censor-in-Chief He Chengtian was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, new year’s day of year 22, the court adopted He Chengtian’s Yuanjia calendar.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，撫軍將軍、南豫州刺史武陵王駿改為雍州刺史，湘州刺史南平王鑠為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On renchen, General Who Pacifies the Army and Southern Yuzhou Inspector Prince of Wuling Jun was made Yongzhou Inspector; Xiangzhou Inspector Prince of Nanping Shuo was made Southern Yuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Prince of Wuling Jun moved from Southern Yuzhou to Yongzhou, and Prince of Nanping Shuo from Xiangzhou to Southern Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，以侍中王僧朗為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinsi, Palace Attendant Wang Silang was made Xiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinsi, palace attendant Wang Silang was appointed Xiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，立第八皇子褘為東海王，第九皇子昶為義陽王。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the eighth imperial son Hui was established as Prince of Donghai, and the ninth imperial son Chang as Prince of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the eighth prince Hui was enfeoffed as Prince of Donghai and the ninth prince Chang as Prince of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 夏六月辛亥，以南豫州刺史南平王鑠為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, on xinhai, Southern Yuzhou Inspector Prince of Nanping Shuo was made Yuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the sixth summer month, Prince of Nanping Shuo was transferred from Southern Yuzhou to Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，以尚書僕射孟顗為尚書左僕射，中護軍何尚之為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiwei, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Meng Yi was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; General Who Protects the Army He Shangzhi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the seventh autumn month, Meng Yi became left vice director of the Masters of Writing and He Shangzhi right vice director.

sentences.zh: 雍州刺史武陵王駿討緣沔蠻，移一萬四千餘口於京師。

translations.literal: Yongzhou Inspector Prince of Wuling Jun attacked the Man along the Han River and moved more than fourteen thousand households to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Wuling Jun, Yongzhou inspector, campaigned against Han River tribes and resettled more than fourteen thousand households at the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，征北大將軍、南兗州刺史衡陽王義季改為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On yiyou, General Who Campaigns in the North and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Hengyang Yiji was made Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Prince of Hengyang Yiji was transferred from northern campaigning general and Southern Xuzhou to Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，[32]開酒禁。

translations.literal: On jiwei of the ninth month, [32] the prohibition on wine was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the ninth month, [32] the ban on wine was revoked.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，起湖熟廢田千頃。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, a thousand qing of abandoned fields at Hushu were brought back into cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, a thousand qing of fallow land at Hushu were reopened.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，太子詹事范曄謀反，及黨與皆伏誅。

translations.literal: On yiwei of the twelfth month, Crown Prince Household Steward Fan Ye plotted rebellion; he and his faction were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the twelfth month, Fan Ye, crown prince household steward, was convicted of treason; he and his associates were put to death.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，免大將軍彭城王義康為庶人。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Grand General Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was stripped of rank and made a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Grand General Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was demoted to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以前豫州刺史趙伯符為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On gengxu, former Yuzhou Inspector Zhao Bofu was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, former Yuzhou inspector Zhao Bofu was appointed general who protects the army.

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月丁巳，以長沙內史陸徽為益州刺史。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of year 23, on dingsi, Interior Minister of Changsha Lu Hui was made Yi Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the twenty-third year’s first spring month, Changsha interior minister Lu Hui became Yi Province inspector.

sentences.zh: 庚申，尚書左僕射孟顗去職。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Meng Yi left office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, left vice director Meng Yi resigned his post.

sentences.zh: 遷漢川流民於沔次。

translations.literal: Migrants from the Han River region were resettled along the Mian.
translations.idiomatic: Han River refugees were relocated to the banks of the Mian.

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，以左衞將軍劉義賓為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guimao, General of the Left Guard Liu Yibin was made Southern Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the second month, left guard general Liu Yibin was appointed Southern Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 三月，索虜寇兗、豫，青、冀刺史申恬破之。

translations.literal: In the third month, the Northern Wei raided Yan and Yu; Qing and Ji Inspector Shen Tian defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the Northern Wei attacked Yan and Yu; Shen Tian, inspector of Qing and Ji, routed them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on dingwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the fourth summer month a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the new moon of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, new moon of the sixth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 交州刺史檀和之伐林邑國，剋之。

translations.literal: Jiao Province Inspector Tan Hezhi attacked the state of Linyi and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Hezhi, Jiao Province inspector, campaigned against Linyi and conquered the kingdom.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，以散騎常侍杜坦為青州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Du Tan was made Qingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the seventh autumn month, scattered cavalry regular attendant Du Tan became Qingzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，揭陽赭賊攻建安郡，燔燒城府。

translations.literal: On guimao of the eighth month, the cinnabar-bandits of Jieyang attacked Jian’an commandery and burned the prefectural city and offices.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the eighth month, Jieyang’s cinnabar rebels stormed Jian’an, burning the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，車駕幸國子學，策試諸生，答問凡五十九人。

translations.literal: On jimao of the ninth month, the imperial carriage visited the Imperial Academy, examined the students by question and answer, and fifty-nine in all replied.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the ninth month the emperor went to the Imperial Academy, tested the students, and fifty-nine answered satisfactorily.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，詔曰：「庠序興立累載，冑子肄業有成。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuzi, an edict said: "The schools have stood for many years, and the sons of the nobility have completed their studies."
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the tenth winter month an edict declared: "Our academies have stood for years, and the crown students have finished their training."

sentences.zh: 近親策試，覩濟濟之美，緬想洙、泗，永懷在昔。

translations.literal: Having recently examined them in person, we behold their splendid array and, gazing toward Zhu and Si, ever cherish the past.
translations.idiomatic: In testing them lately we saw their splendid ranks and, thinking of Zhu and Si, felt anew the age of the sages.

sentences.zh: 諸生答問，多可採覽。

translations.literal: The students’ answers for the most part may be adopted and reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Most of the students’ replies are fit to be read and kept.

sentences.zh: 教授之官，並宜沾賚。

translations.literal: The instructors in office should all receive rewards."
translations.idiomatic: Their teachers in office are all to receive gifts."

sentences.zh: 」賜帛各有差。

translations.literal: Cloth was bestowed in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Silks were granted in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，以龍驤司馬蕭景憲為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingyou of the twelfth month, Rapid Cavalry Staff Officer Xiao Jingxian was made Jiao Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the twelfth month, rapid cavalry staff officer Xiao Jingxian was appointed Jiao Province inspector.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大有年。

translations.literal: That year was a great harvest year.
translations.idiomatic: That year brought an abundant harvest.

sentences.zh: 築北堤，立玄武湖，築景陽山於華林園。

translations.literal: The northern embankment was built, Black Tortoise Lake was established, and Jingyang Hill was constructed in the Hualin Park.
translations.idiomatic: They built the northern dike, opened Black Tortoise Lake, and raised Jingyang Hill in Hualin Park.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春正月甲戌，大赦天下，文武賜位一等。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of year 24, on jiaxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire; civil and military officials were granted one rank in status.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the twenty-fourth year’s first spring month a general amnesty was declared and civil and military officials advanced one rank.

sentences.zh: 繫囚降宥，諸逋負寬減各有差。

translations.literal: Bound prisoners were pardoned by reduction; overdue obligations were leniently reduced in differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Prisoners received graded pardons and overdue levies were eased by degree.

sentences.zh: 孤老、六疾不能自存，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: Orphans, the aged living alone, and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves were each granted five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Each orphan, solitary elder, or person disabled by the six infirmities who could not live without aid received five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 蠲建康、秣陵二縣今年田租之半。

translations.literal: Half this year’s land tax of Jiankang and Moling counties was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Jiankang and Moling were granted a half remission of this year’s land tax.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，護軍將軍趙伯符遷職。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renshen, General Who Protects the Army Zhao Bofu was transferred to another post.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen of the third month, Zhao Bofu left the post of general who protects the army.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲戌，青州刺史杜坦加冀州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on jiaxu, Qingzhou Inspector Du Tan was given the additional post of Jizhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the fifth summer month, Du Tan of Qingzhou was also made Jizhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 六月，京邑疫癘，丙戌，使郡縣及營署部司，普加履行，給以醫藥。

translations.literal: In the sixth month a pestilence struck the capital; on bingxu, the commanderies, counties, camps, and offices were all ordered to make a general inspection tour and supply medicine.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month plague ravaged the capital; on bingxu every commandery, county, camp, and office was ordered to tour its jurisdiction and provide medicine.

sentences.zh: 是月，以貨貴，制大錢一當兩。

translations.literal: That month, because goods were dear, large coins were made to count as two.
translations.idiomatic: That month, with prices high, large coins were decreed to pass at double value.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，以林邑所獲金銀寶物，班賚各有差。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yimao, the gold, silver, and treasures taken from Linyi were distributed in graded rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the seventh autumn month, booty of gold, silver, and gems from Linyi was handed out in graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，征北大將軍、徐州刺史衡陽王義季薨。

translations.literal: On yiwei of the eighth month, General Who Campaigns in the North and Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Hengyang Yiji died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the eighth month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, northern campaigning general and Xuzhou inspector, died.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以南兗州刺史劉義賓為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On guimao, Southern Xuzhou Inspector Liu Yibin was made Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Liu Yibin moved from Southern Xuzhou to Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，以中領軍沈演之為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On jiwei of the ninth month, General of the Central Household Guards Shen Yanzhi was made General of the Household Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the ninth month, Shen Yanzhi was promoted from central to full household guards general.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以太子詹事徐湛之為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Crown Prince Household Steward Xu Zhanzhi was made Southern Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, crown prince household steward Xu Zhanzhi became Southern Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，豫章胡誕世反，殺太守桓隆之，前交州刺史檀和之南還至豫章，因討平之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on renwu, Hu Danshi of Yuzhang rebelled and killed Prefect Huan Longzhi; former Jiao Province Inspector Tan Hezhi, returning south, reached Yuzhang and there suppressed and pacified the revolt.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the tenth winter month, Yuzhang’s Hu Danshi rose in revolt and slew the prefect; Tan Hezhi, former Jiao inspector returning south, crushed the rebellion at Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以建平王宏為中護軍。

translations.literal: On renchen, Prince of Jianping Hong was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Prince of Jianping Hong was appointed general who protects the army.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，立第十皇子渾為汝陰王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiayin, the tenth imperial son Hun was established as Prince of Ruyin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the eleventh month, the tenth prince Hun was enfeoffed as Prince of Ruyin.

sentences.zh: 二十五年春正月戊辰，詔曰：「比者冰雪經旬，薪粒貴踊，貧弊之室，多有窘罄。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of year 25, on wuchen, an edict said: "Recently ice and snow lasted many days; firewood and grain rose steeply in price, and poor households were often left in desperate want."
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the twenty-fifth year’s first spring month an edict declared: "Snow and ice have lingered for weeks; fuel and grain have soared, and many poor homes are at the edge of ruin."

sentences.zh: 可檢行京邑二縣及營署，賜以柴米。」

translations.literal: Let the two capital counties and the camps be inspected and supplied with firewood and grain."
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the two metropolitan counties and the military camps and issue firewood and grain."

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，詔曰：「安不忘虞，經世之所同；

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengyin, an edict said: "In security do not forget peril—this all ages share in common;"
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the second month an edict declared: "Peace must not erase vigilance—every age has known this;"

sentences.zh: 治兵教戰，有國之恒典。

translations.literal: to train the army and teach warfare is the constant statute of a state.
translations.idiomatic: drilling troops and teaching battle is the standing law of any realm.

sentences.zh: 故服訓明恥，然後少長知禁。

translations.literal: Therefore through drilled obedience and clear shame, young and old alike learn restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Only when discipline and shame are clear do young and old learn their bounds.

sentences.zh: 頃戎政雖修，而號令未審。

translations.literal: Recently military affairs have been maintained, yet orders are not yet clear.
translations.idiomatic: Military affairs have lately been kept up, but the commands are still vague.

sentences.zh: 今宣武場始成，便可剋日大習眾軍。

translations.literal: Now that the Martial Display Ground is newly completed, on a set day the mass of armies may undergo great drill.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the Martial Display Ground is finished, a day should be fixed for a grand review of all forces.

sentences.zh: 當因校獵，肄武講事。」

translations.literal: There should be a hunt in connection with the review, to practice arms and discuss affairs."
translations.idiomatic: A hunt is to accompany the review, to exercise arms and rehearse command."

sentences.zh: 閏月己酉，大蒐于宣武場。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on jiyou, a great hunt was held at the Martial Display Ground.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the intercalary month a great hunt was held on the Martial Display Ground.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，車駕校獵。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengchen, the imperial carriage conducted a hunt review.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen of the third month the emperor led a ceremonial hunt.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，新作閶闔、廣莫二門，改先廣莫門曰承明，開陽曰津陽。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yisi, the new Changle and Guangmo gates were built; the former Guangmo gate was renamed Chenming, and Kaiyang was renamed Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the fourth summer month new Changle and Guangmo gates were built; old Guangmo became Chenming and Kaiyang became Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以撫軍將軍、雍州刺史武陵王駿為安北將軍、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On yimao, General Who Pacifies the Army and Yongzhou Inspector Prince of Wuling Jun was made General Who Pacifies the North and Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Prince of Wuling Jun became northern pacifying general and Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以右衞將軍蕭思話為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On guihai, General of the Right Guard Xiao Sihua was made Yongzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, right guard general Xiao Sihua was appointed Yongzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，罷大錢當兩。

translations.literal: On jimao of the fifth month, the large coin valued at two was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the fifth month the double-value large coin was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，零陵王司馬元瑜薨。

translations.literal: On gengxu of the sixth month, Staff Officer to the Prince of Lingling Sima Yuanyu died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, staff officer to the Prince of Lingling Sima Yuanyu died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，安北將軍、徐州刺史武陵王駿加兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengshen, General Who Pacifies the North and Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Wuling Jun was given the additional post of Yanzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Prince of Wuling Jun, northern pacifying general and Xuzhou inspector, was also made Yanzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，車騎將軍、荊州刺史南譙王義宣進位司空。

translations.literal: On bingyin, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan advanced to Minister of Works.
