translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, general of chariots and cavalry and Jingzhou inspector, was promoted to minister of works.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，左光祿大夫王敬弘薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renwu, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Wang Jinghong died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the seventh autumn month, left grand master of splendid happiness Wang Jinghong died.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，以撫軍參軍劉秀之為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiyou of the eighth month, Pacifying-Army Staff Officer Liu Xiuzhi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the eighth month, pacifying-army staff officer Liu Xiuzhi became inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 甲子，立第十一皇子彧為淮陽王。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the eleventh imperial son Yu was established as Prince of Huaiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the eleventh prince Yu was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaiyang.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，以尚書右僕射何尚之為尚書左僕射，領軍將軍沈演之遷職，吳興太守劉遵考為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On xinwei of the ninth month, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing He Shangzhi was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; General of the Household Guards Shen Yanzhi was transferred to another post; Wuxing Prefect Liu Zunkao was made General of the Household Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the ninth month, He Shangzhi became left vice director, Shen Yanzhi left the household guards, and Liu Zunkao of Wuxing became household guards general.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春正月辛巳，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of year 26, on xinsi, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburban altar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the twenty-sixth year’s first spring month the emperor offered sacrifice at the southern suburb in person.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，車駕陸道幸丹徒，謁京陵。

translations.literal: On jihai of the second month, the imperial carriage went by land road to Dantu and paid respects at the Jing tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the second month the emperor traveled overland to Dantu to worship at the Jing mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，[34]詔曰：「朕違北京，二十餘載，雖云密邇，瞻塗莫從。

translations.literal: On dingsi of the third month, [34] an edict said: "We have been away from the northern capital for more than twenty years; though it is said to be near, we could not behold the road."
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the third month, [34] an edict declared: "For more than twenty years we have been absent from the northern capital; though close at hand on the map, we could not see the road home."

sentences.zh: 今因四表無塵，時和歲稔，復獲拜奉舊塋，展罔極之思，饗讌故老，申追遠之懷。

translations.literal: Now, because the four quarters are without dust and the seasons are harmonious and the year abundant, we have again been able to bow before the old tombs, display boundless grief, feast the old men of former days, and give voice to remembrance of the distant past.
translations.idiomatic: Now, with the realm at peace and the harvest full, we can again worship at the ancestral graves, pour out unbounded mourning, feast the elders, and voice our longing for the dead.

sentences.zh: 固以義兼於桑梓，情加於過沛，永言慷慨，感慰實深。

translations.literal: Thus righteousness joins with the home mulberry and affection exceeds that for the ford at Pei; speaking forever in deep feeling, our gratitude and consolation are truly profound.
translations.idiomatic: Our duty to home and our love for the old ford run deep; stirred beyond measure, we feel gratitude and solace alike.

sentences.zh: 宜聿宣仁惠，覃被率土。

translations.literal: It is fitting to proclaim benevolence broadly and spread it over the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Benevolence should be proclaimed and kindness spread across the land.

sentences.zh: 其大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty is proclaimed for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: Let there be a general amnesty for the empire.

sentences.zh: 復丹徒縣僑舊今歲租布之半。

translations.literal: Half this year’s rent and cloth of Dantu county for migrant households of old is restored.
translations.idiomatic: Dantu’s migrant households receive a half remission of this year’s rent and cloth.

sentences.zh: 行所經縣，蠲田租之半。

translations.literal: In the counties the imperial procession passes through, half the land tax is remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Every county along the route receives a half remission of land tax.

sentences.zh: 二千石官長並勤勞王務，宜有沾錫。

translations.literal: Magistrates at the two-thousand-shi rank who have diligently borne royal affairs should receive rewards.
translations.idiomatic: District magistrates who have labored faithfully in royal service deserve a share of favor.

sentences.zh: 登城三戰及大將戰亡墜沒之家，老病單弱者，普加贍卹。

translations.literal: Households of those who fell in the three battles for the city and in great battles, and households of the aged, sick, and solitary weak, are all to receive relief and support.
translations.idiomatic: Families of men lost in the three city battles and in great engagements, and households of the aged, ill, and helpless, are to be sustained.

sentences.zh: 遣使巡行百姓，問所疾苦。

translations.literal: Envoys are sent to tour among the people and ask what they suffer.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys will tour the people and inquire into their hardships.

sentences.zh: 孤老、鰥寡、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: Orphans, the aged living alone, widowers and widows, and those afflicted with the six infirmities who cannot support themselves are each granted five hu of grain."
translations.idiomatic: Each orphan, solitary elder, widower or widow, or person disabled by the six infirmities who cannot live without aid receives five hu of grain."

sentences.zh: 」遣使祭晉故司空忠肅公何無忌之墓。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the tomb of former Jin Minister of Works, the Loyal and Solemn Lord He Wuji.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to offer sacrifice at the grave of Jin’s loyal minister of works, Lord He Wuji.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，申南北沛下邳三郡復。

translations.literal: On yichou, the three commanderies of Northern and Southern Pei and Xiapi were restored to favor.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Northern Pei, Southern Pei, and Xiapi were granted tax relief.

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「京口肇祥自古，著符近代，衿帶江山，表裏華甸，經塗四達，利盡淮、海，城邑高明，土風淳壹，苞總形勝，實唯名都。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "From of old Jingkou has shown auspicious signs and in recent times has borne the imperial mandate; girdling river and mountain, within and without the splendid heartland, roads run four ways, and the profit of Huai and sea is fully gathered—its cities lofty and bright, its customs pure and single; embracing all strategic advantage, it is truly a famous capital."
translations.idiomatic: A further edict declared: "Jingkou has been blessed since antiquity and marked for empire in our own age—river and hills girdle it, roads meet from four sides, Huai and sea yield their profit, its towns are bright and its people unified; in holding all strategic strength it is truly a great capital."

sentences.zh: 故能光宅靈心，克昌帝業。

translations.literal: Therefore it could illumine the numinous heart and bring the imperial enterprise to flourishing completion.
translations.idiomatic: Hence it could quicken the imperial spirit and crown the founding with success.

sentences.zh: 頃年岳牧遷回，軍民徙散，廛里廬宇，不逮往日。

translations.literal: In recent years provincial governors have been rotated and soldiers and civilians scattered; market lanes and houses do not reach those of former days.
translations.idiomatic: Lately, as governors have come and gone, troops and people have drifted away and the streets no longer match former bustle.

sentences.zh: 皇基舊鄉，地兼蕃重，宜令殷阜，式崇形望。

translations.literal: The old home of the imperial foundation, its territory doubly weighty, should be made prosperous and its stature exalted.
translations.idiomatic: The dynasty’s ancestral seat, doubly honored in rank, should be made rich and its prestige restored.

sentences.zh: 可募諸州樂移者數千家，給以田宅，并蠲復。」

translations.literal: Several thousand households willing to move from other provinces may be recruited, given fields and houses, and granted remissions."
translations.idiomatic: Let several thousand households from other provinces who wish to relocate be enrolled, given land and dwellings, and granted tax exemptions."

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，詔曰：「吾生於此城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingyin, an edict said: "We were born in this city."
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin of the fifth month an edict declared: "We were born in this city."

sentences.zh: 及盧循肆亂，害流茲境。

translations.literal: When Lu Xun ran riot, harm flowed through this region.
translations.idiomatic: When Lu Xun’s rebellion swept the land, this region suffered its ravages.

sentences.zh: 先帝以桑梓根本，實同休戚，復以蒙稚，猥同艱難，情義繾綣，夷險兼備，舊物遺蹤，猶存心目。

translations.literal: The late Emperor, because the mulberry-and-chestnut homeland was truly one in weal and woe with us, and because in tender youth we shared hardship together, bound in deep affection through peril and ease alike, the traces of old things still remain before our eyes.
translations.idiomatic: The late Emperor held our native place as one body with the throne; in our youth we shared its hardships, and old scenes still live in memory.

sentences.zh: 歲月不居，逝踰三紀，時人故老，與運零落。

translations.literal: The years do not stay; more than three decades have passed; the men of that time, old and new, have fallen away with fate.
translations.idiomatic: Time does not wait; thirty years have fled, and the elders of that day have mostly gone to their rest.

sentences.zh: 眷惟既往，倍深感歎。

translations.literal: Looking back on what is past, our grief is doubly deep.
translations.idiomatic: Looking back, our grief is twice as deep.

sentences.zh: 可搜訪于時士庶文武今尚存者，具以名聞。

translations.literal: Let a search be made for civil and military gentlemen of that time, commoners and officials, who still survive, and their names be fully reported."
translations.idiomatic: Seek out any civil or military men of that era, gentle or simple, who still live, and report their names in full."

sentences.zh: 人身已亡而子孫見在，優量賜賚之。

translations.literal: Where the person is dead but sons and grandsons remain, generously assess and bestow rewards."
translations.idiomatic: Where the man himself is gone but descendants survive, grant rewards after generous review."

sentences.zh: 」車駕水路發丹徒，壬午，至京師。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage set out by water route from Dantu; on renwu it reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sailed from Dantu and on renwu reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，婆皇國，壬辰，婆達國，並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the state of Pohuang; on renchen, the state of Bada—both sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Pohuang and on renchen Bada each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，以江州刺史廬陵王紹為南徐州刺史，廣陵王誕為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei, Jiangzhou Inspector Prince of Luling Shao was made Southern Xuzhou Inspector; Prince of Guangling Dan was made Yongzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the seventh autumn month, Prince of Luling Shao became Southern Xuzhou inspector and Prince of Guangling Dan Yongzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，以中護軍建平王宏為江州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiyou of the eighth month, General Who Protects the Army Prince of Jianping Hong was made Jiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the eighth month, Prince of Jianping Hong, general who protects the army, became Jiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以南豐王朗為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On guichou, Prince of Nanfeng Lang was made Xiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Prince of Nanfeng Lang was appointed Xiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，廣陵王誕改封隨郡王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Prince of Guangling Dan was given the new enfeoffment Prince of Suixiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Prince of Guangling Dan was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Suixiang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以中軍將軍、揚州刺史始興王濬為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南徐兗二州刺史，南徐州刺史廬陵王紹為揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiachen, General of the Central Army and Yangzhou Inspector Prince of Shixing Jun was made General Who Campaigns in the North, Opening Office with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, and Inspector of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Luling Shao was made Yangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Prince of Shixing Jun became northern campaigning general with opening office equal to the Three Excellencies and inspector of Southern Xu and Yan; Prince of Luling Shao became Yangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月辛未，制交、寧二州假板郡縣，俸祿聽依臺除。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of year 27, on xinwei, provisional commandery and county posts in Jiao and Ning provinces were regulated; salaries were to follow metropolitan appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the twenty-seventh year’s first spring month, acting prefectures and counties in Jiao and Ning were regularized and salaries aligned with capital standards.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the state of Baekje sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Baekje sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，右將軍、豫州刺史南平王鑠進號平西將軍。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinchou, General of the Right and Yuzhou Inspector Prince of Nanping Shuo was given the title Pacifying-West General.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the second month, Prince of Nanping Shuo, right general and Yuzhou inspector, was made pacifying-west general.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，[35]索虜寇汝南諸郡，陳南頓二郡太守鄭琨、汝陽潁川二郡太守郭道隱委守走。

translations.literal: [35] On xinhai, the Northern Wei raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, prefect of Chen and Nandun, and Guo Daoyin, prefect of Ruyang and Yingchuan, abandoned their posts and fled.
translations.idiomatic: [35] On xinhai the Northern Wei struck Runan; Zheng Kun of Chen and Nandun and Guo Daoyin of Ruyang and Yingchuan deserted their posts and fled.

sentences.zh: 索虜攻懸瓠城，行汝南郡事陳憲拒之。

translations.literal: The Northern Wei attacked Xuanhu city; Chen Xian, acting for Runan commandery, resisted them.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Wei besieged Xuanhu; Chen Xian, acting Runan administrator, held the city.

sentences.zh: 以軍興減百官俸三分之一。

translations.literal: Because of the military emergency, the salaries of the hundred offices were reduced by one-third.
translations.idiomatic: With war upon the realm, every official salary was cut by a third.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，淮南太守諸葛闡求減俸祿同內百官，於是州及郡縣丞尉並悉同減。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yichou, Huainan Prefect Zhuge Chan requested that salaries be reduced like those of the inner hundred offices; thereupon the provinces and commanderies, and all assistant and commandant ranks, were all reduced alike.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the third month, Huainan prefect Zhuge Chan asked that local salaries match the capital cut; province, commandery, assistant, and commandant pay were all reduced together.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，罷國子學。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Imperial Academy was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the Imperial Academy was closed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以新除吏部尚書蕭思話為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On yiyou, the newly appointed Minister of Personnel Xiao Sihua was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, newly appointed minister of personnel Xiao Sihua became general who protects the army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，安北將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on renzi, General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces Prince of Wuling Jun was reduced in rank to General Who Stabilizes the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the fourth summer month, Prince of Wuling Jun was demoted from northern pacifying general and Xu-Yan inspector to stabilizing-army general.

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，侍中蕭斌為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingyou, Palace Attendant Xiao Bin was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the sixth month, palace attendant Xiao Bin became inspector of Qing and Ji.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，遣寧朔將軍王玄謨北伐。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengwu, Pacifying-North General Wang Xuamo was sent on a northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the seventh autumn month, pacifying-north general Wang Xuamo was dispatched on the northern expedition.

sentences.zh: 太尉江夏王義恭出次彭城，總統諸軍。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Prince of Jiangxia Yigong went out and encamped at Pengcheng, commanding all the armies in chief.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Prince of Jiangxia Yigong marched to Pengcheng to take supreme command of the armies.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，索虜碻磝戍委城走。

translations.literal: On yihai, the Northern Wei garrison at Qiaolao abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the Northern Wei garrison at Qiaolao abandoned the fortress and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 冬閏月癸亥，玄謨攻滑臺，不克，為虜所敗，退還碻磝。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month of winter, on guihai, Xuamo attacked Huatai but did not take it; he was defeated by the barbarians and retreated to Qiaolao.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai of the winter intercalary month, Wang Xuamo assaulted Huatai, failed, was beaten by the enemy, and fell back to Qiaolao.

sentences.zh: 辛未，雍州刺史隨王誕遣軍攻弘農城，克之。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Yongzhou Inspector Prince of Sui Dan sent troops to attack Hongnong city and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Prince of Sui Dan, Yongzhou inspector, sent forces against Hongnong and captured it.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，又克關城。

translations.literal: On bingxu, they again took Tong Pass city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu his troops also took Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，索虜陷鄒山，魯、陽平二郡太守崔邪利沒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuzi, Zou Mountain was lost to the Northern Wei; Cui Xieli, prefect of Lu and Yangping, was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the eleventh month, Zou Mountain fell; Cui Xieli, prefect of Lu and Yangping, was taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 甲午，隨王誕所遣軍又攻陝城，克之。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the army sent by Prince of Sui Dan again attacked Shan city and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Dan’s detached force again stormed Shan city and took it.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，左軍將軍劉康祖於壽陽尉武戍與虜戰敗見殺。

translations.literal: On guimao, General of the Left Army Liu Kangzu was defeated and killed in battle at Shouyang at the Wuwei garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, left army general Liu Kangzu was defeated and slain at the Wuwei post near Shouyang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On dingwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，內外纂嚴。

translations.literal: On wuwu of the twelfth month, martial law was imposed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu of the twelfth month the court imposed martial law inside and out.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，冗從僕射胡崇之、太子積弩將軍臧澄之、建威將軍毛熙祚於盱眙與虜戰敗，並見殺。

translations.literal: On yichou, Attendant of the Retinue Hu Chongzhi, General of the Crown Prince’s Strong Crossbows Zang Chengzhi, and General Who Establishes Might Mao Xizuo were defeated by the barbarians at Xuyi and all were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Hu Chongzhi, Zang Chengzhi, and Mao Xizuo were routed by the enemy at Xuyi and all slain.

sentences.zh: 庚午，虜偽主率大眾至瓜步。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the barbarian pretender ruler led a great host to Guabu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the Northern Wei emperor advanced with a great army to Guabu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On renwu, martial precaution was imposed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the court ordered precautionary martial law throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 二十八年春正月丙戌朔，以寇逼不朝會。

translations.literal: On bingxu, new year’s day of the first month of spring in year 28, because the enemy pressed close, the court audience was not held.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, new year’s day of year 28, the new-year audience was cancelled because the enemy was near.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，索虜自瓜步退走。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Northern Wei withdrew from Guabu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the Northern Wei army retreated from Guabu.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，攻圍盱眙城。

translations.literal: On dingyou, they besieged Xuyi city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou they laid siege to Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 是月，寧朔將軍王玄謨自碻磝退還歷下。

translations.literal: That month, Pacifying-North General Wang Xuamo retreated from Qiaolao to Lixia.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wang Xuamo withdrew from Qiaolao to Lixia.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，索虜自盱眙奔走。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingchen, the Northern Wei fled in disorder from Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the second month the Northern Wei broke camp and fled from Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔曰：「玁狁孔熾，難及數州，眷言念之，鑒寐興悼。

translations.literal: On guiyou, an edict said: "The Xianyun are fiercely rampant, touching several provinces; thinking of it with care, we grieve waking and sleeping."
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou an edict declared: "The northern foe rages across many provinces; we mourn them waking and sleeping."

sentences.zh: 凶羯痍挫，迸跡遠奔，彫傷之民，宜時振理。

translations.literal: The vicious Jie, wounded and broken, have fled far in flight; the people they maimed should now be restored in season.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy, battered and spent, has fled into the distance; the maimed people must be healed in good time.

sentences.zh: 凡遭寇賊郡縣，令還復居業，封屍掩骼，賑贍饑流。

translations.literal: In all commanderies and counties that suffered bandit raids, order them to return and resume their occupations; cover the exposed dead and bury the bones; relieve and support the hungry and displaced.
translations.idiomatic: Every raided commandery and county is to bring people back to their trades, bury the dead, and feed the refugees.

sentences.zh: 東作方始，務盡勸課。

translations.literal: Eastern fieldwork is just beginning; strive to the utmost in encouragement and supervision.
translations.idiomatic: Spring planting has begun; press every effort in encouragement and oversight.

sentences.zh: 貸給之宜，事從優厚。

translations.literal: The terms for loans and grants should be generously favorable.
translations.idiomatic: Grain loans and relief are to be granted on generous terms.

sentences.zh: 其流寓江、淮者，並聽即屬，并蠲復稅調。

translations.literal: Those who have drifted to lodge along the Yangzi and Huai are all permitted to register where they are and are granted remissions of tax and corvée."
translations.idiomatic: Refugees along the Yangzi and Huai may register locally and receive tax and corvée remissions."

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，太尉、領司徒江夏王義恭降為驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Grand Commandant and Concurrent Minister over the Masses Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was reduced to General of Fast Cavalry, Opening Office with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was demoted from grand commandant and minister over the masses to fast-cavalry general with opening office equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，鎮軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號北中郎將。

translations.literal: On xinsi, General Who Stabilizes the Army and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces Prince of Wuling Jun was reduced in rank to Northern Center Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Prince of Wuling Jun was demoted from stabilizing-army general and Xu-Yan inspector to northern center commander.

sentences.zh: 壬午，車駕幸瓜步，是日解嚴。

translations.literal: On renwu, the imperial carriage visited Guabu; that day martial precaution was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the emperor went to Guabu and martial precaution was lifted the same day.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On yiyou of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the third month the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，征北將軍始興王濬解南兗州。

translations.literal: On renchen, General Who Campaigns in the North Prince of Shixing Jun relinquished Southern Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Prince of Shixing Jun gave up Southern Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以輔國將軍臧質為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Assisting-State General Zang Zhi was made Yongzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, assisting-state general Zang Zhi became Yongzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 戊申，徐州刺史武陵王駿為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wushen, Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Wuling Jun was made Southern Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Prince of Wuling Jun moved from Xuzhou to Southern Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，護軍將軍蕭思話為撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiayin, General Who Protects the Army Xiao Sihua was made General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Xiao Sihua became pacifying-army general and inspector of Xu and Yan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，婆達國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on guiyou, the state of Bada sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the fourth summer month, Bada sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 索虜偽寧南將軍魯爽、中書郎魯秀歸順。

translations.literal: The Northern Wei pretender Pacifying-South General Lu Shuang and Secretariat Gentleman Lu Xiu submitted in allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Wei pacifying-south general Lu Shuang and secretariat gentleman Lu Xiu defected to the Song.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以爽為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Lu Shuang was made Sizhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Lu Shuang was appointed Sizhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，亡命司馬順則自號齊王，據梁鄒城。

translations.literal: On yiyou of the fifth month, the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou city.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the fifth month, fugitive Sima Shunze declared himself king of Qi and held Liangzou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，婆皇國，戊戌，河南王，並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the state of Pohuang; on wuxu, the King of Henan—all sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Pohuang and on wuxu the king of Henan each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: [37]己巳，驃騎將軍江夏王義恭領南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: [37] On jisi, General of Fast Cavalry Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was given the concurrent post of Southern Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: [37] On jisi, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, fast-cavalry general, also became Southern Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以尚書左僕射何尚之為尚書令，太子詹事徐湛之為尚書僕射、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On renzi, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing He Shangzhi was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Crown Prince Household Steward Xu Zhanzhi was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, He Shangzhi became director of the Masters of Writing, and Xu Zhanzhi vice director and general who protects the army.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以後將軍隨王誕為安南將軍、廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On renyin, Rear General Prince of Sui Dan was made General Who Pacifies the South and Guangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Prince of Sui Dan became southern pacifying general and Guangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，以北中郎將武陵王駿為江州刺史，以振武將軍、秦郡太守劉興祖為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On renxu of the sixth month, Northern Center Commander Prince of Wuling Jun was made Jiangzhou Inspector; Pacifying-Wu General and Qin Commandery Prefect Liu Xingzu was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu of the sixth month, Prince of Wuling Jun became Jiangzhou inspector, and Liu Xingzu of Qin commandery inspector of Qing and Ji.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，安東將軍倭王倭濟進號安東大將軍。

translations.literal: On jiachen of the seventh month of autumn, Pacifying-East General the Wa King Yuji was promoted to Pacifying-East Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the seventh autumn month, the Wa king Yuji was promoted from pacifying-east general to pacifying-east grand general.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，梁鄒平，斬司馬順則。

translations.literal: On guihai of the eighth month, Liangzou was pacified and Sima Shunze was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai of the eighth month Liangzou was taken and Sima Shunze executed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guihai, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the tenth winter month, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，曲赦二兗、徐、豫、青、冀六州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renyin, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the six provinces of the two Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the eleventh month a partial amnesty was granted to the two Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji.

sentences.zh: 是冬，徙彭城流民於瓜步，淮西流民於姑孰，合萬許家。

translations.literal: That winter, migrants from Pengcheng were resettled at Guabu, and migrants from west of the Huai at Gushu—together about ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Pengcheng refugees were moved to Guabu and Huai-west refugees to Gushu—roughly ten thousand families in all.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春正月甲午，詔曰：「經寇六州，居業未立，[38]仍值災澇，饑困荐臻。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of year 29, on jiawu, an edict said: "The six provinces that suffered raids still have not established their livelihoods, [38] and again meet with flood disaster; hunger and distress come in succession."
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the twenty-ninth year’s first spring month an edict declared: "Six raided provinces have not yet rebuilt their livelihoods, [38] and now floods have struck again; hunger follows hunger."

sentences.zh: 可速符諸鎮，優量救卹。

translations.literal: Orders are to be sent quickly to the military districts to grant relief generously by assessment.
translations.idiomatic: Send urgent orders to the frontier commands to relieve the people generously.

sentences.zh: 今農事行興，務盡地利。

translations.literal: Now agricultural work is rising; strive to the utmost in the land’s benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Spring work is underway; exploit every advantage of the soil.

sentences.zh: 若須田種，隨宜給之。」

translations.literal: Where field seed is needed, supply it as appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: Where seed is lacking, issue it as local conditions require."

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，虜帥拓跋燾死。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengshen, the Northern Wei ruler Tuoba Tao died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the second month the Northern Wei emperor Tuoba Tao died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，[39]立第十二皇子休仁為建安王。

translations.literal: On wuwu, [39] the twelfth imperial son Xiuren was established as Prince of Jian’an.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, [39] the twelfth prince Xiuren was enfeoffed as Prince of Jian’an.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，訶羅單國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on wuwu, the state of Heluodan sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the fourth summer month, Heluodan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 以驃騎參軍張永為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: Fast-Cavalry Staff Officer Zhang Yong was made Jizhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yong, staff officer to the fast-cavalry general, became Jizhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，罷湘州并荊州。

translations.literal: On jiawu of the fifth month, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu of the fifth month Xiangzhou was abolished and absorbed into Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 以始興、臨賀、始安三郡屬廣州，丙申，詔曰：「惡稔身滅，戎醜常數，虐虜窮凶，著於自昔。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict said: "When wickedness is full the man perishes; the barbarian foe has ever been thus numbered; the cruel captive, utterly vicious, is manifest from of old."
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict declared: "Evil ripened brings ruin; the northern foe has always been so; their savage ruler, steeped in cruelty, has shown it since antiquity."

sentences.zh: 未勞資斧，已伏天誅，子孫相殘，親黨離貳，關、洛偽帥，並懷內款，河朔遺民，注誠請効。

translations.literal: Without wearying our axes, they have already submitted to Heaven’s punishment; sons and grandsons slaughter one another, kin and factions split apart; the false commanders of Guan and Luo all harbor intent to submit inwardly, and the remnant people north of the River pour forth loyalty and ask to serve.
translations.idiomatic: We need not even swing the axe: they have already met Heaven’s judgment; their heirs turn on one another and their kin divide; the puppet warlords of Guan and Luo all wish to come over, and refugees north of the River offer their loyalty and beg to fight for us.

sentences.zh: 拯溺蕩穢，今其會也。

translations.literal: To rescue the drowning and sweep away the filth—now is the occasion.
translations.idiomatic: To save the perishing and cleanse the realm—this is the hour.

sentences.zh: 可符驃騎、司空二府，各部分所統，東西應接。

translations.literal: Order may be sent to the General of Agile Cavalry and Minister of Works offices, each dividing what they command, to connect east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Issue orders to the Agile Cavalry and Minister of Works staffs, each to deploy its commands and coordinate east and west.

sentences.zh: 歸義建績者，隨勞酬獎。

translations.literal: Those who submit in allegiance and establish merit are to be rewarded according to labor.
translations.idiomatic: Defectors who prove their worth shall be rewarded in proportion to their service.

sentences.zh: 」是月，京邑雨水。

translations.literal: " That month the capital had rain flooding.
translations.idiomatic: " That month flooding rains struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，遣部司巡行，賜樵米，給船。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiyou, ministry officials were dispatched on tour, firewood and grain were granted, and boats were supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiyou: touring officials were sent out, fuel and grain distributed, and boats provided.

sentences.zh: 撫軍將軍蕭思話率眾北伐。

translations.literal: Pacifying Army General Xiao Sihua led the host on a northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying-army general Xiao Sihua marched north at the head of his army.

sentences.zh: 以征北從事中郎劉瑀為益州刺史。

translations.literal: Campaigning-North staff officer Liu Yu was made Yi Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu, staff officer to the campaigning-north general, was appointed inspector of Yi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，汝陰王渾改封武昌王，淮陽王彧改封湘東王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, Prince of Ruyin Hun was enfeoffed as Prince of Wuchang, and Prince of Huaiyang Yu as Prince of Xiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, renchen: Prince of Ruyin Hun became Prince of Wuchang; Prince of Huaiyang Yu became Prince of Xiangdong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，省大司農、太子僕、廷尉監官。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the offices of Grand Minister of Agriculture, Steward of the Heir Apparent, and Supervisor of the Court of Justice were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Dingyou: the grand minister of agriculture, heir-apparent steward, and court-of-justice supervisor posts were cut.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，蕭思話攻碻磝，不拔，退還。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingmao, Xiao Sihua attacked Qiaoyao but could not take it and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingmao: Xiao Sihua assaulted Qiaoyao, failed to capture it, and retreated.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，以平西將軍吐谷渾拾寅為安西將軍、秦河二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dinghai, Pacifying-West General Tuyuhun Shibin was made Anxi General and Inspector of Qin and He provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dinghai: Tuyuhun Shibin, pacifying-west general, was made Anxi general and inspector of Qin and He.

sentences.zh: 己丑，撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史蕭思話加冀州刺史，兗州如故。

translations.literal: On jichou, Pacifying Army General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces Xiao Sihua was additionally made Inspector of Ji; Yanzhou remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Jichou: pacifying-army general and Xu-Yan inspector Xiao Sihua also received Ji; his Yanzhou post was unchanged.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，司州刺史魯爽攻虎牢不拔，退還。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guihai, Inspector of Si Province Lu Shuang attacked Hulao but could not take it and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, guihai: Si inspector Lu Shuang besieged Hulao, failed, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，揚州刺史廬陵王紹薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renyin, Prince of Luling Shao, Yangzhou Inspector, died.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renyin: Prince of Luling Shao, inspector of Yang, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，以驃騎將軍、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為大將軍、南徐州刺史，錄尚書事如故。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinwei, General of Agile Cavalry and Southern Yanzhou Inspector Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was made Grand General and Southern Xuzhou Inspector, retaining his post supervising the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinwei: agile-cavalry general and Southern Yanzhou inspector Prince of Jiangxia Yigong became grand general and Southern Xuzhou inspector, still supervising the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 三十年春正月戊寅，以司空、荊州刺史南譙王義宣為司徒、中軍將軍、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of year 30, on wuyin, Minister of Works and Jing Province Inspector Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan was made Grand Secretary, Central Army Commander, and Yangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Year 30, first spring month, wuyin: minister of works and Jing inspector Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan became grand secretary, central army commander, and Yangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 以南兗州并南徐州。

translations.literal: Southern Yanzhou was merged into Southern Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Yan was absorbed into Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以領軍將軍劉遵考為平西將軍、豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Colonel of the Guards Liu Zunkao was made Pacifying-West General and Yu Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Gengchen: guards colonel Liu Zunkao was made pacifying-west general and Yu inspector.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以征北將軍、南徐州刺史始興王濬為衛將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On renwu, Campaigning-North General and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Shixing Jun was made Guard General and Jing Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Renwu: campaigning-north general and Southern Xu inspector Prince of Shixing Jun became guard general and Jing inspector.

sentences.zh: 戊子，江州刺史武陵王駿統眾軍伐西陽蠻。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Prince of Wuling Jun commanded the mass of armies to attack the Xiyang barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzi: Prince of Wuling Jun led the combined armies against the Xiyang tribes.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以豫州刺史南平王鑠為撫軍將軍、領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On guisi, Yu Province Inspector Prince of Nanping Shuo was made Pacifying Army General and Colonel of the Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Guisi: Yu inspector Prince of Nanping Shuo became pacifying-army general and guards colonel.

sentences.zh: 青、徐州饑，二月壬子，遣運部賑卹。

translations.literal: Qing and Xu provinces suffered famine; in the second month, on renzi, the Transport Office was dispatched to grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: Famine in Qing and Xu: second month, renzi, the transport office was sent to relieve distress.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上崩于含章殿。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the Emperor died at Hanzhang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Jiazi: the emperor died in Hanzhang Hall.

sentences.zh: 時年四十七。

translations.literal: He was forty-seven years of age.
translations.idiomatic: He was forty-seven.

sentences.zh: 諡曰景皇帝，廟曰中宗。

translations.literal: His posthumous name was Emperor Jing; his temple name was Zhongzong.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous title Emperor Jing; temple name Zhongzong.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，葬長寧陵。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guisi, he was buried at Changning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, guisi: interment at Changning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 世祖踐阼，追改諡及廟號。

translations.literal: When Shizu took the throne, he retroactively changed the posthumous name and temple name.
translations.idiomatic: Once Shizu acceded, he revised the posthumous and temple designations.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：太祖幼年特秀，顧無保傅之嚴，而天授和敏之姿，自禀君人之德。

translations.literal: The historian says: In his youth the Founding Emperor was exceptionally gifted; though he lacked the strictness of tutors and protectors, Heaven bestowed a harmonious, keen nature, and he was himself endowed with the virtue of a ruler of men.
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: The Founding Emperor showed rare promise as a boy; without rigid tutoring he still possessed Heaven-given harmony and quickness—the makings of a true sovereign.

sentences.zh: 及正位南面，歷年長久，綱維備舉，條禁明密，罰有恒科，爵無濫品。

translations.literal: Once he faced south and held the throne, his years were long; the net of governance was fully spread, statutes and prohibitions clear and close, punishments had fixed measures, and ranks had no indiscriminate grades.
translations.idiomatic: Once enthroned he ruled many years: institutions were complete, law meticulous, penalties standardized, and ennoblement never careless.

sentences.zh: 故能內清外晏，四海謐如也。

translations.literal: Thus within was purity and without was peace; the four seas were tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the realm was ordered within and calm without—all under Heaven was still.

sentences.zh: 昔漢氏東京常稱建武、永平故事，自茲厥後，亦每以元嘉為言，斯固盛矣。

translations.literal: Formerly the Eastern Han of the Han house often spoke of the precedents of Jianwu and Yongping; from that time onward people also regularly cited the Yuanjia era—truly it was a flourishing age.
translations.idiomatic: Han scholars praised Jianwu and Yongping; later ages likewise held up Yuanjia as a golden age—and rightly so.

sentences.zh: 授將遣帥，乖分閫之命，才謝光武，而遙制兵略，至於攻日戰時，莫不仰聽成旨。

translations.literal: In appointing generals and dispatching commanders he went against the custom of dividing frontier authority; his talent fell short of Emperor Guangwu’s, yet he controlled strategy from afar—when it came to the day of battle, none failed to look up and await the completed decree.
translations.idiomatic: He named generals yet withheld their command: no Guangwu in talent, but he micromanaged every campaign—on the day of battle his officers waited only for edicts from the throne.

sentences.zh: 雖覆師喪旅，將非韓、白，而延寇慼境，抑此之由。

translations.literal: Though armies were shattered and hosts lost, and his generals were no Han Xin or Bai Qi, yet that the enemy lingered and the borderlands suffered—this too had its cause here.
translations.idiomatic: Defeats piled up and his commanders were no match for Han Xin or Bai Qi; still, that the foe prolonged the war and ravaged the marches owed much to this habit.

sentences.zh: 及至言漏衾衽，難結商豎，雖禍生非慮，蓋亦有以而然也。

translations.literal: When at last words leaked from the bedchamber and trouble bound itself to a peddler, though calamity arose unlooked-for, there was reason for it to be so.
translations.idiomatic: When whispers escaped the royal bed and a merchant’s grudge entangled the court, disaster seemed sudden—yet the seeds had long been sown.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！

translations.literal: Alas, how lamentable!
translations.idiomatic: Alas—how pitiable!

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Textual collation notes

sentences.zh: 車駕至京城 孫虨宋書考論云：「當作京邑。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage reached the capital city. Sun Ao’s Studies on the Song History says: "It should read the capital metropolis."
translations.idiomatic: Imperial arrival at Jingcheng. Sun Ao’s Song History Studies: "Read Jingyi (metropolis), not Jingcheng."

sentences.zh: 京城則京口矣。

translations.literal: The capital city would be Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: Jingcheng here means Jingkou (modern Zhenjiang).

sentences.zh: 」按通鑑作建康。

translations.literal: " According to the Comprehensive Mirror it reads Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: " Zizhi Tongjian has Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 宋書京城往往指京口城，此則指建康。

translations.literal: In the Song History "capital city" often means Jingkou city; here it means Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Song Shu usually uses Jingcheng for Jingkou; this passage means Jiankang (Nanjing).

sentences.zh: 辛未車駕祠南郊 各本並脫「辛未」二字，據南史、建康實錄、通鑑補。

translations.literal: On xinwei the imperial carriage sacrificed at the southern suburb. All editions alike omit the two characters "xinwei"; supplemented according to the History of the Southern Dynasties, Jiankang shilu, and the Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: Xinwei, imperial southern-suburb sacrifice: every edition drops xinwei; restored from Nanshi, Jiankang shilu, and Tongjian.

sentences.zh: 建安太守潘盛有罪伏誅 「潘盛」各本作「潘城」，據少帝紀、徐羨之傳改。

translations.literal: Administrator of Jian’an Pan Sheng, guilty of crimes, was executed. "Pan Sheng" in all editions reads "Pan Cheng"; changed according to the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Xu Xianzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Jian’an administrator Pan Sheng executed for crime. All texts read Pan Cheng; corrected per the deposed emperor’s annals and Xu Xianzhi’s biography.

sentences.zh: 乙卯 各本並作「己卯」，據局本及南史改。

translations.literal: Yimao. All editions read jimao; changed according to the Bureau edition and the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: Yimao: every edition has jimao; emended per the Bureau text and Nanshi.

sentences.zh: 按是月丁酉朔，十九日乙卯，無己卯。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month’s new moon was on dingyou; the nineteenth day was yimao—there was no jimao.
translations.idiomatic: That month’s new moon was dingyou; day 19 was yimao, so jimao is impossible.

sentences.zh: 領平北將軍南徐州刺史 各本並脫「南」字，按彭城王義康傳、建康實錄、通鑑並作南徐州刺史，今據補。

translations.literal: Concurrent Pacifying-North General and Southern Xuzhou Inspector. All editions omit the character "South"; according to the biography of Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Jiankang shilu, and the Comprehensive Mirror all read Southern Xuzhou Inspector—now supplemented.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying-north general and Southern Xu inspector: all editions drop Nan (south); Pengcheng prince’s biography, Jiankang shilu, and Tongjian agree—Nan restored.

sentences.zh: 以前征虜司馬尹沖為司州刺史 各本並脫「尹」字，按索虜傳，時尹沖為司州刺史，通鑑同。

translations.literal: Former Campaigning-North staff officer Yin Chong was made Si Province Inspector. All editions omit the character "Yin"; according to the biography of the northern enemy, at the time Yin Chong was Si Province Inspector—the Comprehensive Mirror agrees.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Chong, former campaigning-north staff officer, made Si inspector: Yin is missing in all editions; the Rouran biography and Tongjian confirm him in office.

sentences.zh: 今據補。

translations.literal: Now supplemented.
translations.idiomatic: Restored accordingly.

sentences.zh: 征南大將軍檀道濟破索虜於東平壽張 各本並脫「平」字。

translations.literal: Campaigning-South Grand General Tan Daoji defeated the northern enemy at Dongping Shouzhang. All editions omit the character "ping."
translations.idiomatic: Tan Daoji, campaigning-south grand general, routed the northerners at Dongping Shouzhang: every edition omits ping in Dongping.

sentences.zh: 據檀道濟傳補。

translations.literal: Supplemented according to the biography of Tan Daoji.
translations.idiomatic: Added from Tan Daoji’s biography.

sentences.zh: 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「按檀道濟傳作東平壽張，此『東』下脫『平』字。」

translations.literal: Hong Yixuan’s Various Histories Textual Studies says: "According to the biography of Tan Daoji it reads Dongping Shouzhang; below ‘Dong’ the character ‘ping’ is omitted."
translations.idiomatic: Hong Yixuan, Various Histories: "Tan Daoji’s biography has Dongping Shouzhang—ping is missing after Dong."

sentences.zh: 苟不深存務本 各本並脫「苟」字，據元龜一九八補。

translations.literal: If one does not deeply preserve the root task. All editions omit the character "if"; supplemented according to Yuan gui 198.
translations.idiomatic: "If one does not deeply preserve the root task": gou (if) is absent in all editions; supplied from Yuan gui 198.

sentences.zh: 以吐谷渾慕容延為平東將軍 「慕容延」本書吐谷渾傳作「慕延」。

translations.literal: Murong Yan of Tuyuhun was made Pacifying-East General. "Murong Yan" in this book’s Tuyuhun biography reads "Mu Yan."
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun Murong Yan made pacifying-east general: the Tuyuhun biography in this book reads Mu Yan.

sentences.zh: 魏書作「慕利延」。

translations.literal: The Wei History reads "Muli Yan."
translations.idiomatic: Wei Shu: Muli Yan.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾輝伐為鎮軍將軍 各本並脫「谷」字，據前後文例補。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun Hui Fa was made Pacifying Army General. All editions omit the character "gu" in Tuyuhun; supplemented according to the pattern of the preceding and following text.
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun Hui Fa made pacifying-army general: Gu in Tuyuhun is dropped in all editions; restored by context.

sentences.zh: 「輝伐」魏書作「緯代」。

translations.literal: "Hui Fa" in the Wei History reads "Weidai."
translations.idiomatic: Wei Shu: Weidai for Huifa.

sentences.zh: 壬申河南國河西王遣使獻方物 「河西王」各本作「西河王」，據少帝紀景平元年及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。

translations.literal: On renshen the King of Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys presenting tribute goods. "King of Hexi" in all editions reads "King of Xihe"; changed according to the Annals of the Deposed Emperor, year 1 of Jingping, and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.
translations.idiomatic: Renshen: Henan and Hexi kings sent tribute missions. Xihe in all texts should be Hexi; corrected per the deposed emperor’s annals (Jingping 1) and Juqu Mengxun’s biography.

sentences.zh: 亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山 三朝本作「泰山」，弘治本、北監本、毛本、殿本、局本作「秦梁」。

translations.literal: Outlaw Ma Daxuan and a band of several hundred men raided Taishan. The Sanchao edition reads "Taishan"; the Hongzhi, Northern Directorate, Mao, Hall, and Bureau editions read "Qin and Liang."
translations.idiomatic: Rebel Ma Daxuan, several hundred strong, raided Taishan. Sanchao has Taishan; Hongzhi, Beijian, Mao, Dian, and Bureau texts read Qinliang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉 按是月丁亥朔，無乙酉。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, yiyou. According to the calendar, that month’s new moon was on dinghai—there was no yiyou.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, yiyou: that month’s new moon was dinghai, so yiyou cannot stand.

sentences.zh: 二十三日己酉，「乙酉」或是「己酉」之譌。

translations.literal: The twenty-third day was jiyou; "yiyou" may be a corruption of "jiyou."
translations.idiomatic: Day 23 was jiyou; yiyou is likely a scribal error for jiyou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉 「辛酉」各本並作「乙酉」，據南史改。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, xinyou. "Xinyou" in all editions reads "yiyou"; changed according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, xinyou: every edition has yiyou; corrected per Nanshi.

sentences.zh: 按是月庚戌朔，初六日辛酉，無「乙酉」。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month’s new moon was on gengxu; the sixth day was xinyou—there was no "yiyou."
translations.idiomatic: New moon gengxu; day 6 xinyou—yiyou is impossible.

sentences.zh: 於益州立南晉壽南新巴北巴西三郡 各本並作「於益州立南晉壽新巴西三郡」。

translations.literal: In Yi Province were established the three commanderies of Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi. All editions read "In Yi Province were established the three commanderies of Southern Jinshou, Xinba, and Baxi."
translations.idiomatic: Yi Province gained three commanderies—Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, Northern Baxi. All editions collapse them to Southern Jinshou, Xinba, and Baxi.

sentences.zh: 孫虨宋書考論云：「據州郡志，是南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。

translations.literal: Sun Ao’s Studies on the Song History says: "According to the Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies, these are the three commanderies of Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi."
translations.idiomatic: Sun Ao’s Song Studies: the Provincial Gazetteer lists Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi.

sentences.zh: 」按孫說是，今訂正。

translations.literal: " According to Sun, this is correct; now emended.
translations.idiomatic: " Sun is right; text emended.

sentences.zh: 又此條上云「壬申」，下云「乙亥」。

translations.literal: Moreover, in this entry above it says "renshen" and below "yihai."
translations.idiomatic: This note also has renshen above and yihai below.

sentences.zh: 按是月丙戌朔，無壬申，亦無乙亥。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month’s new moon was on bingxu; there was no renshen, and no yihai.
translations.idiomatic: That month’s new moon was bingxu; neither renshen nor yihai occurs.

sentences.zh: 以步兵校尉劉真道為梁南秦二州刺史 「劉真道」各本並作「劉道真」。

translations.literal: Footsoldier Colonel Liu Zhendao was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces. "Liu Zhendao" in all editions reads "Liu Daozhen."
translations.idiomatic: Footsoldier colonel Liu Zhendao made Liang and Southern Qin inspector: all editions read Liu Daozhen.

sentences.zh: 張森楷校勘記云：「當作劉真道，見劉懷肅傳，下十八年亦作劉真道。

translations.literal: Zhang Senkai’s collation note says: "It should read Liu Zhendao; see the biography of Liu Huaisu; in year 18 below it also reads Liu Zhendao."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Senkai: read Liu Zhendao (Liu Huaisu biography; year-18 entry agrees).

sentences.zh: 」按張說是，今改正。

translations.literal: " According to Zhang, this is correct; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang is correct; emended.

sentences.zh: 河南國河西王訶羅單國並遣使獻方物 「河西王」各本並作「西河王」，據少帝紀及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。

translations.literal: The King of Henan, the King of Hexi, Heluodan nation, and Poluo Huang nation all sent envoys presenting tribute goods. "King of Hexi" in all editions reads "King of Xihe"; changed according to the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.
translations.idiomatic: Henan king, Hexi king, Heluodan, and Poluo Huang sent tribute. Xihe for Hexi in all texts—corrected per deposed-emperor annals and Juqu Mengxun.

sentences.zh: 燕王弘遣使獻方物 「弘」各本並作「年」，據晉書載記改。

translations.literal: Prince of Yan Hong sent envoys presenting tribute goods. "Hong" in all editions reads "nian"; changed according to the Jin History annals.
translations.idiomatic: Yan prince Hong sent tribute: nian in all editions should be Hong, per Jin Shu annals.

sentences.zh: 今年有不收處 「年」各本並作「半」，據元龜四八九改。

translations.literal: Where this year there are places without harvest. "Year" in all editions reads "half"; changed according to Yuan gui 489.
translations.idiomatic: "Where this year there are places without harvest": nian (year) appears as ban (half) in all editions; fixed per Yuan gui 489.

sentences.zh: 以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射 「王球」各本並作「王琳」，據南史、通鑑改。

translations.literal: Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Qiu was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing. "Wang Qiu" in all editions reads "Wang Lin"; changed according to the History of the Southern Dynasties and the Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qiu, director of the Masters of Writing, made vice director: Wang Lin in all texts—corrected per Nanshi and Tongjian.

sentences.zh: 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「王球作王琳，是傳寫之譌。」

translations.literal: Hong Yixuan’s Various Histories Textual Studies says: "Wang Qiu written as Wang Lin is a corruption in transmission."
translations.idiomatic: Hong Yixuan: Wang Qiu miswritten Wang Lin is a copyist’s error.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬午 「壬午」各本作「壬申」。

translations.literal: Fifth month of summer, renwu. "Renwu" in all editions reads "renshen."
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fifth month, renwu: all editions have renshen.

sentences.zh: 局本作「壬午」。

translations.literal: The Bureau edition reads "renwu."
translations.idiomatic: Bureau text: renwu.

sentences.zh: 按是月壬午朔，無壬申。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month’s new moon was on renwu; there was no renshen.
translations.idiomatic: That month’s new moon was renwu; renshen is impossible.

sentences.zh: 今從局本。

translations.literal: Now following the Bureau edition.
translations.idiomatic: Adopted from the Bureau edition.

sentences.zh: 尚書僕射王球卒 「球」各本並作「琳」，據南史、通鑑改。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Qiu died. "Qiu" in all editions reads "Lin"; changed according to the History of the Southern Dynasties and the Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: Vice director Wang Qiu died: Lin in all texts should be Qiu, per Nanshi and Tongjian.

sentences.zh: 是月 各本並作十二月。

translations.literal: That month. All editions read "twelfth month."
translations.idiomatic: "That month": every edition says twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 按上已有十月，十一月，十二月，不當重出十二月。

translations.literal: According to the text above, there were already the tenth, eleventh, and twelfth months; the twelfth month should not appear again.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth, eleventh, and twelfth months already appear above—a second twelfth month is wrong.

sentences.zh: 今改作是月。

translations.literal: Now changed to read "that month."
translations.idiomatic: Changed to "that month."

sentences.zh: 盛王聖世 「聖」各本並作「祖」，據元龜一九四改。

translations.literal: Flourishing age, sagely world. "Sagely" in all editions reads "ancestral"; changed according to Yuan gui 194.
translations.idiomatic: "Flourishing age, sagely world": sheng (sagely) is zu (ancestral) in all editions; emended per Yuan gui 194.

sentences.zh: 始奉礿祠 「礿」各本並作「初」，據元龜二０七改。

translations.literal: For the first time performing the yue sacrifice. "Yue" in all editions reads "initial"; changed according to Yuan gui 207.
translations.idiomatic: "For the first time performing the yue sacrifice": yue is chu (initial) in all editions; fixed per Yuan gui 207.

sentences.zh: 庚申 各本同。

translations.literal: Gengshen. All editions agree.
translations.idiomatic: Gengshen: all editions agree.

sentences.zh: 按是月壬申朔，初三日甲戌，是月無庚申。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month’s new moon was on renshen; the third day was jiaxu—there was no gengshen in that month.
translations.idiomatic: New moon renshen; day 3 jiaxu—no gengshen that month.

sentences.zh: 下有甲申，為十三日。

translations.literal: Below there is jiashen, which is the thirteenth day.
translations.idiomatic: Jiashen below is day 13.

sentences.zh: 甲戌、甲申之間有庚辰。

translations.literal: Between jiaxu and jiashen there is gengchen.
translations.idiomatic: Between jiaxu and jiashen stands gengchen.

sentences.zh: 庚申疑庚辰之譌。

translations.literal: Gengshen is suspected to be a corruption of gengchen.
translations.idiomatic: Gengshen is probably a mistake for gengchen.

sentences.zh: 南徐南豫州揚州之浙江西 各本同。

translations.literal: Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and the region west of the Zhe River in Yang Province. All editions agree.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and Yang west of the Zhe: all editions agree.

sentences.zh: 南史於「南徐」下有「南兗」二字。

translations.literal: The History of the Southern Dynasties below "Southern Xu" has the two characters "Southern Yan."
translations.idiomatic: Nanshi inserts Southern Yan after Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 南豫州刺史武陵王駿加撫軍將軍 「駿」各本作「贊」，三朝本作「諱」。

translations.literal: Southern Yu Province Inspector Prince of Wuling Jun was additionally made Pacifying Army General. "Jun" in all editions reads "Zan"; the Sanchao edition reads "taboo."
translations.idiomatic: Southern Yu inspector Prince of Wuling Jun made pacifying-army general: Jun is Zan in all texts, taboo in Sanchao.

sentences.zh: 按時武陵王駿，即後之孝武帝。

translations.literal: According to the time, Prince of Wuling Jun was the later Emperor Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: At this date Prince of Wuling Jun is the future Emperor Xiaowu.

sentences.zh: 贊為宋明帝第九子，後亦封武陵王，時尚未生。

translations.literal: Zan was the ninth son of Emperor Ming of Song; he was later also enfeoffed as Prince of Wuling, but at the time he had not yet been born.
translations.idiomatic: Zan is Emperor Ming’s ninth son, later Prince of Wuling too—but not yet born here.

sentences.zh: 今改作「駿」。

translations.literal: Now changed to read "Jun."
translations.idiomatic: Corrected to Jun.

sentences.zh: 征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣為車騎將軍荊州刺史 「南徐州刺史」各本並脫「南」字，據義宣傳補。

translations.literal: Campaigning-North General, Southern Xuzhou Inspector, and Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan was made Chariots-and-Cavalry General and Jing Province Inspector. "Southern Xuzhou Inspector" in all editions omits the character "South"; supplemented according to the biography of Yixuan.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigning-north general, Southern Xu inspector Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan became chariots-and-cavalry general and Jing inspector: Nan (south) is missing before Southern Xu; restored from Yixuan’s biography.

sentences.zh: 九月己未 「己未」各本並作「乙未」，局本作「己未」。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiwei. "Jiwei" in all editions reads "yimao"; the Bureau edition reads "jiwei."
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month jiwei: yimao in all texts, jiwei in the Bureau edition.

sentences.zh: 按是月丁巳朔，初三日己未，無乙未。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month’s new moon was on dingsi; the third day was jiwei—there was no yimao.
translations.idiomatic: New moon dingsi; day 3 jiwei—yimao cannot occur.

sentences.zh: 今從局本。

translations.literal: Now following the Bureau edition.
translations.idiomatic: Adopted from the Bureau edition.

sentences.zh: 遷漢川流民於沔次 「漢川」各本作「漢州」，按時無「漢州」，據元龜四八六改。

translations.literal: Relocating Han River refugees to the bank at Mian. "Han River" in all editions reads "Han Prefecture"; at the time there was no "Han Prefecture"—changed according to Yuan gui 486.
translations.idiomatic: Resettling Hanchuan refugees on the Han shore: every edition has Hanzhou instead of Hanchuan, but no Hanzhou existed then; emended per Yuan gui 486.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳 下有乙丑。

translations.literal: Third month, dingsi; below it is yichou.
translations.idiomatic: Third month dingsi; yichou follows below.

sentences.zh: 各本同。

translations.literal: All editions agree.
translations.idiomatic: Every edition is the same.

sentences.zh: 按是月丁卯朔，無丁巳，亦無乙丑。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, in the third month the new moon was on dingmao; there was no dingsi, and no yichou.
translations.idiomatic: Per the calendar the third-month new moon fell on dingmao; neither dingsi nor yichou could occur.

sentences.zh: 四月丙申朔，二十二日丁巳，三十日乙丑。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the new moon was on bingchen; the twenty-second day was dingsi, and the thirtieth day yichou.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth-month new moon bingchen; day 22 was dingsi and day 30 yichou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥 各本並作「辛巳」。

translations.literal: Xinhai. All editions read xinsi.
translations.idiomatic: Xinhai: all editions have xinsi.

sentences.zh: 通鑑考異云：「按長曆，二月壬辰朔，十日辛丑，二十日辛亥。

translations.literal: Tongjian Kaoyi says: "According to the long calendar, in the second month the new moon was on renchen, the tenth day xinchou, and the twentieth day xinhai.
translations.idiomatic: Zizhi Tongjian Collation says: "Per the long calendar, second-month new moon renchen, tenth day xinchou, twentieth day xinhai.

sentences.zh: 辛巳當作辛亥。

translations.literal: Xinsi should be emended to xinhai."
translations.idiomatic: Xinsi should read xinhai."

sentences.zh: 」今據改。

translations.literal: Now changed accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 安北將軍徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍 「駿」宋本作「諱」。

translations.literal: Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces Prince of Wuling Jun was reduced in rank to Pacifying Army General. "Jun" in the Song edition reads "taboo."
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying-north general and Xu-Yan inspector Prince of Wuling Jun was demoted to pacifying-army general; the Song edition uses the taboo form for Jun.

sentences.zh: 三朝本、北監本、毛本、殿本作「贊」，今據孝武帝紀訂正。

translations.literal: The Sanchao, Northern Directorate, Mao, and Hall editions read "Zan"; now corrected according to the Annals of Emperor Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: Sanchao, Beijian, Mao, and Dian editions read Zan; corrected per the Xiaowu annals.

sentences.zh: 說見本卷校勘記第三十條。

translations.literal: Explanation in textual collation note 30 of this juan.
translations.idiomatic: See textual collation note 30 in this juan.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉亡命司馬順則自號齊王據梁鄒城丁巳婆皇國戊戌河南王並遣使獻方物 按是年五月甲申朔，初二日乙酉，十五日戊戌，無丁巳。

translations.literal: Fifth month yiyou: outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and held Liangzhou city; dingsi Poluo Huang nation; wuxu Henan King—all sent envoys presenting tribute goods. According to that year’s fifth month, new moon on jiashen, second day yiyou, fifteenth day wuxu; there was no dingsi.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month yiyou: rebel Sima Shunze declared himself King of Qi and seized Liangzhou; entries for dingsi (Poluo Huang) and wuxu (Henan King) with tribute missions cannot stand—that month’s new moon was jiashen (day 2 yiyou, day 15 wuxu), with no dingsi.

sentences.zh: 丁巳日支當有誤。

translations.literal: The dingsi day-entry must be in error.
translations.idiomatic: The dingsi date is certainly wrong.

sentences.zh: 居業未立 「立」各本並作「能」，據元龜一九五改。

translations.literal: Livelihoods not yet established. "Established" in all editions reads "able"; changed according to Yuan gui 195.
translations.idiomatic: "Livelihoods not yet established": every edition has neng (able) for li (established); emended per Yuan gui 195.

sentences.zh: 戊午 各本並作「庚午」，據南史改。

translations.literal: Wuwu. All editions read gengwu; changed according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: Wuwu: all editions read gengwu; corrected per Nanshi.

sentences.zh: 按是月庚戌朔，無庚午。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month’s new moon was on gengxu; there was no gengwu.
translations.idiomatic: That month’s new moon was gengxu; gengwu is impossible.

sentences.zh: 初九日戊午。

translations.literal: The ninth day was wuwu.
translations.idiomatic: Day 9 was wuwu.
